title: Business Intelligence Analyst (Contractor)
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA or Remote (U.S.)

**This is a contract role expected to last until April 15th, 2027 

Location : This role is Remote in the U.S., with the option to work onsite from our San Francisco, CA headquarters.

Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. 

About Doximity 

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role 

As a Business Intelligence Analyst , you will:

- Work closely with our Product, Strategic Analytics, Client Success, and Sales teams to create client-facing analyses.

- Showcase your engineering skills by creating data products from scratch and automating code so they can be re-used by other teammates.

- Continue to improve your technical and non-technical skill sets.

- Leverage Doximity's extensive datasets to identify and classify behavioral patterns of medical professionals on our platform.

- Grow into a presentation/communication-focused role or dive deeper into more-involved technical challenges—the choice is yours.

What We're Looking For 

We're excited to meet candidates who have many of the following qualifications:

Must have: 

- Three (3) years of experience illustrating collaboration, passion for data, reliability, precision, curiosity, and respect for teammates and clients.

- Excellent SQL skills with proven ability to create and evaluate complex SQL statements involving numerous tables and complex relationships.

- Fluent in Python and experience using common modules (numpy, pandas, statsmodels, matplotlib) for EDA.

- Experience collaborating with non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have: 

- Working knowledge of statistics and visualization.

- Experience working with data visualization tools.

- Advanced Excel skills.

- Experience using AI coding assistants and building AI-leveraged workflows.

- Experience working in the healthcare industry.

- Experience presenting data to a non-technical audience.

The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team 

As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.

- Collaboration —The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

- Passion for Data —You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.

- Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.

- Precision – Our team's deliverables power client analysis and inform real-world decisions. A successful candidate will triple check their work and their teammates' work, holding all of us to the highest data quality standards.

- Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.

- Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.

Why You'll Love Working Here 

At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.

- Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.

- Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.

- Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.

- Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.

- Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.

Our Hiring Process & AI Tools 

Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.

Equal Employment Opportunity 

Doximity is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. 

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know so we can support your participation.

title: Full-Stack Engineer - Productions
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

Productions is the “done for you” managed services wing of ElevenLabs, built for creators and media businesses. We bring together our AI audio tools and human experts in linguistics, mixing and post-production to deliver human-edited dubs, audiobooks and more in 15+ languages, directly on the ElevenLabs platform. Our customers include global media broadcasters, publishers, gaming companies and major film studios.

We’re hiring engineers to build the systems behind it: the platforms that let human expertise and AI work together at the quality our clients expect, and the labelling tools our research teams use to improve our models. You’ll own a scope in one of these areas:

- Human data platform: the labelling and evaluation platform research uses to continuously improve our models. You’ll ship new task editors, improve reliability, catch misuse and build the metrics behind higher-quality data pipelines.

- Core productions engine: the backend machine nobody sees but everybody relies on. You’ll build and maintain the services that run our production workflows, with room to lead projects.

- Editor platform: the professional editing tools our production teams work in. You’ll build in Rust, combining UI systems with a deep understanding of the underlying system.

We’re building professional tools and core infrastructure, not consumer features. The work is mostly building, with little hand-holding. You’ll carve out your own scope and own the outcome.

Requirements 

- Strong backend engineering experience, ideally in functional programming languages like Rust, with a full-stack focus on designing UI systems. You’ve shipped and run production systems end to end.

- Experience making systems reliable and scalable, such as internal platforms, workflow or task engines, or data pipelines. You take pride in the infrastructure nobody sees but everybody relies on.

- Comfortable switching between building a new tool or editor and hardening the platform underneath it, and keen to lead projects when the opportunity arises.

- Opinionated and able to defend your ideas, but know when to just grind. You’re happy doing the unglamorous work, and you’re hungry.

Bonus: 

- Experience building editor or UI-heavy professional tools, with a systems-level understanding of what sits underneath.

- Experience with data labelling or annotation platforms, or managing crowdsourced workforces.

Location 

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $75k-$150k/yr (including equity)
description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor. 

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

- The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

- The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

- Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025 : We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

- Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026 : Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

- Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028 : Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

- Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030 : Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

- Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035 : With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS 

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu , our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann , our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO ( Richie ). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

- Strategic ownership : Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

- High-converting web design : Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

- Value propositions : Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

- Follow the scent : Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

- Figma to live : Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

- AI-powered design and build : Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

- Systems that scale : Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

- Ship fast : Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

- Experience : 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

- User psychology : A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

- Value propositions : Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

- Design to code : Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

- AI-native : At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

- Ownership : Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

- Speed : You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

- Craft : High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

- CRO : Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

- Analytics : Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

- Product flows : Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

- Regulated markets : Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

- Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

- Multi-market : Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

- SEO and performance : Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

- Belief in the mission : We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

- Unwavering integrity : We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

- Only the paranoid survive : Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

- If we're average we fail : We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

- Commitment to candor : That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

- A maniacal sense of urgency : We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

- Enduring frugality : We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

- Bulldozing barriers : The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

- Keep your head down : We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

- The power of focus : We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

🎯

"You just build a f\ *ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

- Compensation : $75k-$150k/yr including equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

- Healthcare : comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

- Remote : our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

- Personal development : budget for books, courses, coaching.

- Personal wellness : budget for gym, health apps.

- GLP-1s : free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

- Health coaching : free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

- Work coaching : free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

- Equipment : Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

- What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

Apply via Ashby and be sure to include:

- your resume and portfolio

- 2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion

- a short note on how you use AI in your design and build workflow today

TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in. 

At TYTAN , we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty. 

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Networked Systems to join the Core team within our Platform Team. Everything we build is a node: from small embedded devices to full compute systems and ground infrastructure. Together they operate as one network, in the field and over denied, degraded and intermittent links. You design how this works end to end: how nodes find and connect to each other, how trust propagates, how they communicate, and how every node exposes what the application stack needs. And you build it: the network itself, the node agent that runs on every node, the node API and the SDK. 

Your roadmap to make an impact

- System design: Own the end-to-end design of how our systems connect and communicate: topology, links, transports, delivery semantics and failure behaviour. When a new requirement lands, such as operating a system beyond line of sight over LEO satellite or cellular links, you design how it works: latency budget, link selection and failover, security, and what keeps working when the link drops 

- The network: Build it: addressing plans, routing, segmentation and multi-homing across tactical radio, cellular, satcom and wired links, with dynamic routing and link selection for nodes that move and links that fail 

- Secure links: IPsec/IKEv2 or WireGuard overlays with certificate authentication from hardware-backed keys, including rekeying, NAT traversal and behaviour on link loss 

- Trust: Design how trust propagates from production to the field: device identity, certificate lifecycle, mutual authentication, authorisation tiers, revocation and signed commands that keep working without backend connectivity 

- Node agent: Design and build the agent that runs on every node and exposes identity, health, software state, connectivity and updates through one API, served locally, over the network and in compact form over constrained links. Devices too small to run it are represented through their parent node 

- Node API and SDK: One resource model for every node type, versioned and backward compatible across a fleet that never updates all at once, with SDKs generated from the contract for the languages our teams use 

- Discovery and directory: How nodes find each other with and without infrastructure, and a directory that survives restarts and shows what should exist versus what is present, at fleet scale without polling every node 

- Communication: Build on proven middleware and transports instead of reinventing them, define delivery semantics per traffic class, and engineer QoS so command and control traffic survives congestion on constrained links 

- Network as code: Configuration templated, version controlled, validated in CI and shipped as part of the system release 

- Verification: Network emulation that reproduces measured field link profiles, fault injection in CI, and network test campaigns at test ranges and flight tests with root cause from packet captures 

- Direction: Write the design documents and contracts that embedded, backend and application engineers build against, and review designs 

- Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent experience 

- 5+ years building networked or distributed systems in production, combining software engineering with hands-on network engineering, including technical ownership of a core component other teams depend on 

- Designed a networked system end to end, and can reason through a new connectivity scenario from first principles: topology, latency budget, failure modes and security 

- Expert in Rust, Go or C++, working proficiency in Python, and comfortable reading and writing C++ 

- Strong networking across the stack: IP addressing and routing, UDP, TCP and QUIC internals, congestion control, multicast, NAT traversal, MTU and fragmentation; fluent with Wireshark and tcpdump 

- Expert Linux networking: iproute2, policy routing, network namespaces, VRFs, bridges, VLANs, nftables, tc and netem 

- Production experience with IPsec (strongSwan or libreswan) and WireGuard, including PKI-based authentication 

- Routing: OSPF and BGP (ideally FRRouting or BIRD), and how latency, loss and link quality shape routing and protocol design in dynamic networks 

- Applied security: PKI and certificate lifecycle, mTLS, hardware-backed keys (TPM or secure elements) and authorisation models 

- Built services that run on devices: Linux daemons, systemd, local IPC and resource-constrained environments 

- Experience with middleware such as DDS, ROS 2, Zenoh, ZeroMQ, NATS or gRPC, including discovery, flow control, serialisation and QoS 

- API and contract design consumed by many teams: schema evolution, versioning and backward compatibility 

- Written design documents that other teams implemented against 

- Willingness to travel to test sites and flight tests (around 20%) 

Nice to haves

- Systems built for denied, degraded, intermittent or limited (DDIL) connectivity: defense, robotic fleets, autonomous vehicles, space 

- Beyond-line-of-sight operation over LEO satellite, cellular or long-range radio links 

- Integration of MANET or mesh radios (e.g. Silvus, Doodle Labs, Persistent Systems) and MANET routing such as OLSR or B.A.T.M.A.N. 

- Network emulation with EMANE, CORE, ns-3 or Linux netem 

- Time synchronisation with PTP/gPTP 

- Replication and coordination (Raft, gossip, CRDTs, logical clocks) 

- Embedded ARM targets, RTOS or mixed Linux and RTOS systems 

- Tactical datalinks, defense crypto equipment or interoperability standards such as STANAG 4586 

Why TYTAN? 

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security 

- Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale 

- Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors 

- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback 

- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact 

- Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company 

- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe 

Our Benefits 

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation 

- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit 

- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us 

- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team 

- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together 

- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands 

- Flexibility : Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration 

About us 

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all. 

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process. 

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.

description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor. 

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

- The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

- The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

- Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025 : We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

- Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026 : Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

- Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028 : Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

- Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030 : Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

- Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035 : With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS 

Being a Talent Lead at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team. As Talent Lead at AIOS, your fundamental role is to supercharge our talent (recruiting) function, ensuring that a lack of key hires never blocks growth. You’ll help define what a killer sourcing process looks like while leveraging frontier tooling to increase your throughput and velocity as you recruit best-in-class operators.

You’ll work across a variety of roles: traditional direct-to-consumer Growth roles (Performance Marketing), technical roles (AI + SWE Engineering & Product), and clinical roles — flexing deftly between more junior roles all the way up to the most senior roles in the org.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice — as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday. You’ll have flex in your calendar for kids if you have them — many of our team have kids so we’re kid-friendly.

This is an individual-contributor role — no direct reports, full-cycle sourcing/screening/closing, hands dirty in the trenches. You’ll report directly to Cierra Olsen (Head of Talent).

You’ll also work closely with the rest of the Talent Team: Zoe Wheeler (UK Talent Lead), Mika Mansilla (Founder Associate), and Jordan Pellikan (VP Ops).

Key responsibilities

- Full cycle : Own searches end to end from sourcing, outbound, screening, interview coordination, calibration, and closing (recent examples: Head of InfoSec, Head of Creative, Senior Media Buyer, Affiliate Lead).

- Sourcing : Build repeatable sourcing engines for hard-to-fill roles. Run LinkedIn X-ray searches, build target-company lists, and do the outbound headhunting yourself. Our best hires won’t come inbound.

- Processes : Constantly sharpen our hiring bars (seniority, industry fit, recency, builder pattern) consistently across every search you’re DRI for. Help improve interview processes across the org.

- Hygiene : Keep pipelines, stages, and candidate communication clean and current in Ashby so nothing stalls and our time to hire continually improves.

- Calibration : Flag pipeline risk early, bring calibration questions before they become misses, and constantly align with leaders across the org to improve our processes.

- Closing : Manage candidate experience through to signed offer, including comp conversations.

KPIs

- Time-to-fill on your owned searches, without sacrificing the bar

- Sourced (outbound) candidates as a % of your total pipeline — we want you building your own pipeline, not living off inbound

- Offer-accept rate on closed candidates

- Ashby pipeline hygiene — stages and candidate status always current

Need to have

- Excellence : You have 5+ years experience personally recruiting (sourcing, screening, managing, and closing) great candidates across difficult searches. You can point to hires that materially raised the talent bar of the teams they joined.

- Hunter : You can turn a vague candidate profile into target companies, search strings and a high-quality outbound pipeline. You do not depend on inbound applicants or agencies to fill roles.

- Senior hiring : You have successfully recruited senior leaders and understand how sourcing, assessing and closing them differs from junior hiring.

- Judgment : You can distinguish exceptional people from candidates who simply have the right companies, titles or polish on their CV. You develop conviction quickly and can clearly articulate why someone does or does not meet the bar.

- Range : You can move between very different searches without losing depth. You learn unfamiliar markets quickly enough to recruit credibly within them.

- Multi-workstream : You can run several searches simultaneously while keeping sourcing quality, candidate communication, follow-ups and pipeline hygiene exceptionally tight.

- Urgency : You push searches forward without waiting to be managed, surface problems early, and change approach quickly when a pipeline is not working.

- High bar : You care more about making an exceptional hire than filling a seat, and you are comfortable challenging hiring managers when you do not believe a candidate meets org standards.

Nice to have

- Startups/Scale-ups : You’ve recruited in a fast-moving startup or scale-up where priorities shift quickly, roles evolve mid-search, and there isn’t always an existing playbook.

- Technical recruiting : You’ve successfully recruited for Engineering, AI, Data, Product or other technical roles and can credibly assess candidate quality beyond surface-level credentials.

- Regulated industries : You’ve recruited in healthcare, financial services, or another highly regulated industry where candidate requirements and operating constraints are more complex.

- AI-native : You actively use AI and automation to improve sourcing, research, outreach, screening, and recruiting operations.

- Systems builder : You’ve helped build or materially improve recruiting processes, tooling, scorecards, sourcing systems, or interview loops rather than simply operating an existing process.

- Network : You have an existing network of exceptional operators, builders and leaders you’d be excited to bring into AIOS.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

- Belief in the mission : We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

- Unwavering integrity : We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

- Only the paranoid survive : Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

- If we're average we fail : We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

- Commitment to candor : That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

- A maniacal sense of urgency : We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

- Enduring frugality : We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

- Bulldozing barriers : The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

- Keep your head down : We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

- The power of focus : We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

🎯 "You just build a f\ *ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

- Compensation : $100k-$200k/yr, incl equity

Benefits

- Healthcare : comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

title: Product Engineer
description:
About Adclear 

At Adclear, we’re building the trust layer for how the world’s most regulated companies bring products to market. Every bank, lender and investment platform runs into the same invisible pain: compliance review slows down every campaign, every launch, every idea. We’re turning the function that has always said “no” into infrastructure that says “yes, and here’s how.”

This is a fundamental shift in how regulated industries and compliance teams operate, and we’re only at the beginning. The product you’ll help build is what people actually touch when they experience that shift.

Founded in 2024, we’ve already earned the trust of leading innovators and established enterprises including Monzo, NatWest, PensionBee, Kraken, Coinbase and many others. Our early traction let us raise £2.6m in funding, and we’re now scaling fast. We’re building the product engine that turns a genuinely novel category into something people love to use, and this is where you come in.

The Role 

This is a full-stack product engineering role for someone who has shipped real features and wants to take on more ownership. You’ll work alongside senior engineers and the founders on product slices from spec to production. Over time you’ll own them end-to-end. Here’s the kind of work you’ll contribute to:

- A Chrome extension that runs compliance checks inline in Google Docs, where marketers actually write copy. It was built with Monzo as the design partner and is public on the Chrome Web Store.

- A natural-language copilot for compliance work. Users ask in plain English, the platform proposes typed actions, a human approves, and the action runs.

- The interface where reviewers watch the model reason through a decision, step in when they disagree, and feed structured corrections back into the rules.

- Integrations that reach into wherever customers create marketing: Canva, Figma, Google Docs, Contentful, Workfront, Monday.com , and Frame.io for video.

- A dashboard that takes a long, unsorted list of compliance tasks and turns it into a single prioritised queue.

Our users are compliance and marketing teams at leading fintechs. They use Adclear every day and tell us quickly when something’s wrong. That tight feedback loop is one of the best things about the job, and it’s a fast way to grow.

What you’ll do 

- Ship product features from spec to production. Most of the work is across the full stack, and integration work where needed. You’ll start with guidance and take on bigger slices as you grow.

- Build the surfaces compliance reviewers live in: workflows, review UIs, and the moments where model output meets human judgement.

- Work on features where AI is in the critical path. The model is genuinely part of the product, not bolted on.

- Ship a change to production on your first day and a feature in your first few weeks. We deploy continuously, so you’ll feel the pace immediately.

- Bring your perspective to what we build and how we build it. We want to hear when something doesn’t make sense.

- Learn from senior engineers through code review, pairing and design discussions, and help raise the bar yourself.

What we’re looking for 

- Proven delivery. Building production web applications, with features you’ve shipped that real users depend on.

- Growing ownership. You can take a well-scoped feature and run with it. You know when to ask for input and when to unblock yourself. You want to grow towards owning larger, more ambiguous pieces of work.

- Product sense. You care about the user experience, notice when something feels off, and aren’t afraid to say so. You’re learning to balance polish against shipping at pace.

- Collaboration. You communicate clearly with engineers, designers and founders, ask good questions when something is underspecified, and are receptive to feedback.

- AI literacy. You use modern coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, agents) day to day. You treat them as collaborators, check their output critically, and are curious about where they help and where they get in the way.

Technical skills 

- Solid TypeScript and React, with working experience on the backend.

- Experience with, or a strong interest in, building products where AI is in the critical path.

- Familiarity with modern web tooling, including Node and Postgres.

Nice to have 

- Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Hono or Drizzle.

- Exposure to regulated industries such as fintech, healthtech or legaltech.

The Stack 

React, TypeScript and Tailwind on the frontend. A Hono API on Cloudflare Workers. Drizzle and Postgres on the data layer.

Compensation 

- Competitive salary

- Meaningful equity

- Private healthcare and dental

- Hardware budget

- Monthly gym contribution

- Professional development budget

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract)
description:
Headquarters: Australia 

URL: https://www.askablelabs.com/ 

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works 

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering

- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

- Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

- Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

- Regular use of an AI coding tool

- Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

- You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

- At least 10 hours a week, starting now

- A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have 

- Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

- Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms 

- US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

- Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

- The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

- Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

-

Knowledge about test design and security fundamentals.

Basics about how AI models work.

title: Software Engineer (80-100%)
description:
Worum geht es?

Wenn in der Schweiz eine Feuerwehr alarmiert wird, läuft die Meldung mit hoher Wahrscheinlichkeit über unsere Systeme. Rund 400 Feuerwehren in 16 Kantonen arbeiten mit unseren Lösungen, von der Alarmierung über die Einsatzführung bis zur Einsatzplanung.

Das heisst: Unsere Software muss funktionieren, auch nachts um 3 Uhr. Diese Verantwortung prägt, wie wir entwickeln.

Wir suchen dich als Software Engineer, der unsere Plattform mitträgt. Nicht als weitere Person im Team, sondern als eine tragende Säule in unserem Team.

Über uns

Die EvoSys AG wurde 2011 gegründet und entwickelt seit 2016 eigene Software für Behörden und Organisationen für Rettung und Sicherheit (BORS). Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen in Thun mit 9 Mitarbeitenden und in unserem Markt führend.

Unsere Produkte heissen AlarmHub, Intervento, FloriPlan, AlarmDisplay und SpotPilot. Sie decken den ganzen Ablauf ab, von der Alarmierung bis zur Auswertung nach dem Einsatz. 2028 kommt mit Respondo eine weitere Lösung dazu.

Deine Aufgaben

- Du entwickelst unsere bestehenden Plattformen weiter und setzt neue Funktionen von der Idee bis in den Betrieb um.

- Du prägst unsere Architektur mit. Unsere Kundenbasis wächst stark, und unsere Systeme müssen mitwachsen. Konkret bereiten wir den Schritt auf Kubernetes vor und bauen Dienste so um, dass sie zuverlässig skalieren.

- Du arbeitest an Schnittstellen zu Einsatzzentralen, Partnersystemen und Behördenplattformen.

- Du setzt KI-gestützte Werkzeuge im Entwicklungsalltag ein, so wie wir alle.

- Du nimmst an Code Reviews teil und trägst zu Qualität und Dokumentation bei.

- Du unterstützt bei anspruchsvollen technischen Fragen aus dem Betrieb.

Perspektive

Mit der Zeit kannst du die fachliche Verantwortung für einen Produktbereich übernehmen. Und wenn es für beide Seiten passt, ist längerfristig auch eine technische Führungsrolle denkbar. Solche Rollen besetzen wir aus dem Team heraus. Voraussetzung für diese Stelle ist das aber ausdrücklich nicht.

Deine Aufgaben

- Rund 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von Webanwendungen. Die ersten Jahre hast du hinter dir und arbeitest selbständig, ohne enge Begleitung.

- Erfahrung mit Node.js und Vue.js, dazu Berührungspunkte mit PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux und Git.

- Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge selbstverständlich und kannst beurteilen, wann du ihrem Ergebnis trauen kannst und wann nicht.

- Verständnis dafür, was im Produktivsystem passiert, wenn dein Code dort ankommt.

- Lust, Verantwortung für ein Thema zu übernehmen, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten.

- Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englischverständnis.

- Interesse am Blaulichtumfeld. Eigene Erfahrung in einer Feuerwehr oder im Zivilschutz ist ein Plus, aber keine Bedingung.

Unser Technologiestack

- Node.js, TypeScript, Vue.js

- PostgreSQL und Redis

- Docker - auf dem Weg zu Kubernetes

- Linux, Git, CI/CD-Pipelines

- REST-APIs und Schnittstellen zu Drittsystemen

- KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge

Was dich bei uns erwartet

- Kurze Wege. Ein Standort, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsleitung. Entscheide fallen am selben Tag, nicht im nächsten Gremium.

- Sichtbare Wirkung. Was du baust, ist innert Wochen bei Feuerwehren im Einsatz. Du bekommst Rückmeldungen von Menschen, die damit arbeiten.

- Weiterbildung, die wir ernst meinen. Wir unterstützen berufsbegleitende Studiengänge.

- 5 Wochen Ferien, bei Teilzeit anteilig.

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein modern ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz.

- Mitgestaltung. Technologieentscheide treffen wir gemeinsam, nicht von oben herab.

- Thun. Arbeiten zwischen See und Bergen, 10 Minuten vom Bahnhof, 20 Minuten von Bern.

Ein Hinweis mit Ehrlichkeit

Wir arbeiten überwiegend vor Ort. Einzelne Homeoffice-Tage sind möglich, reine Remote-Arbeit passt nicht zu uns. Die kurzen Abstimmungswege in der Entwicklung gehören zu unserer DNA.

Vergütung

Der Lohn für diese Stelle liegt bei CHF 68'000-80'000 pro Jahr bei einem Pensum von 100%.

So läuft die Bewerbung ab

- Bewerbung über die Plattform. Lebenslauf genügt, ein Motivationsschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Links zu Projekten oder Repositories schauen wir uns gerne an.

- Kurzes Kennenlernen, rund 30 Minuten per Video oder Telefon.

- Gespräch in Thun mit dem CTO und dem Entwicklungsteam, inkl. Blick in unsere Codebasis.

- Fachlicher Austausch anhand einer kleinen, realistischen Aufgabe. Kein Whiteboard-Rätsel, sondern etwas aus unserem Alltag.

- Entscheid spätestens 7 Tage nach dem letzten Gespräch.

Wir melden uns auf jede Bewerbung zurück, auch bei einer Absage.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People. 

About Onebrief 

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists 

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do 

Core responsibilities:

- Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

- Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

- Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

- Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

- Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

- Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

- Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

- Turn field experience into patterns . Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

- Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications 

- Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility. 

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

- Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

- Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

- Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

- Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

- Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications 

- Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

- Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

- Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

- Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

- Presales experience, including building and delivering demos

Your work will directly impact our ability to handle increasing customer volume while reducing operational costs and improving team efficiency through smart automation and process optimization.

Systems Integration: Design, implement, and maintain integrations between key operational systems and our product infrastructure. Create automated workflows that enhance efficiency and data accuracy across platforms.

Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate and improve support workflows, identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency gains through technical solutions.

Technical Skills: Strong programming experience with proficiency in SQL and at least one modern programming language (Python, JavaScript, etc.). Experience with Laravel and Nuxt/Vue preferred. Experience with API integrations and webhook implementations.

- 
Systems Experience: Hands-on experience with customer support platforms (Intercom preferred), CRM systems, and ancillary software (MixMax, Zapier, Outreach, etc). Understanding of modern SaaS architecture and integration patterns.

LLM/ML Knowledge: Familiarity with AI platforms and their practical applications in customer support contexts. Experience implementing and managing AI-powered solutions is a plus.

Operations Background: 3+ years of experience in technical operations, customer operations, or similar roles where you've built or maintained support systems at scale.

Analysis & Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills with experience in data analysis and visualization tools. Ability to translate complex operational problems into technical solutions.

- 
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- 
Customer Focus: Deep understanding of customer support operations and how technology can enhance the customer experience.

Working At Peerspace 

The annual salary range for this role is $110,000 to $120,000. The actual salary amount will vary depending on the applicant’s experience, skills, and abilities as well as internal equity and market data.

● Laptop, high res display, and stipend to setup home office

● Monthly cell phone and internet credit

● Annual In person all company offsite and team-building events (in Peerspace locations, of course)

● Wellness Days observed company wide

Diversity 

At Peerspace, we're dedicated to creating a team that's diverse, equitable and inclusive. Our workplace is a space where all team members are empowered to blaze their own trail, make things happen, and take pride in their work. We believe bringing people together from different backgrounds and identities makes us stronger and better serves the Peerspace community. We'd especially like to encourage applicants from different backgrounds, locations, and experiences.

At Peerspace, we are committed to maintaining a secure and transparent hiring experience. Please be aware that scammers sometimes impersonate companies like ours by posting fake job listings or reaching out to job seekers in misleading ways. title: Front End Design Engineer
description:
About Seamflow 

Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files.

Where we are:

- Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry

- $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

- Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists.

The team 

Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.

The role 

A Front End Design Engineer thinks in finished interfaces, not mockups or components in isolation. A technical reviewer at a notified body spends their day inside a 400-page technical file, cross-referencing clauses, checking test reports against standards, and deciding whether a medical device is safe to sell. Today they do that in Word, Acrobat and a spreadsheet someone built in 2011. The interface they use decides how fast they work and whether they trust the AI sitting next to them.

You own that interface. Layout, typography, interaction, motion, the design system underneath it, and the React that ships it. You decide how a reviewer sees a finding, how they correct a model that got it wrong, and how a hundred fields of dense regulatory data become something a person can actually read. You sketch it, build it, ship it, then sit next to someone using it and find out what you got wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week.

What we're looking for 

We care far more about taste and engineering strength than about matching a list of tools. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in React, Svelte, Vue or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, craft and speed are not.

What we're actually screening for:

- You've designed and built an interface that real people used every day. Not a Dribbble shot, not a component library nobody adopted. Something that shipped, got used, and got better.

- You have taste, and you can defend it. Typography, spacing, motion, hierarchy. You notice when something is a few pixels off and you can explain why it matters.

- You build the whole thing. Design, frontend, the state and data it sits on. You don't hand the code to someone else once the Figma is done, and you don't hand the design to someone else once the code is.

- You can design for density. Expert users, complex workflows, hundreds of fields on a screen. Making that clear is much harder than making a landing page beautiful.

- You go to the source. You'll watch a technical reviewer work through a real file, and you'll design for what they actually do rather than what the process diagram says.

Signals we like, none of them required:

design engineering or front-end roles at somewhere like Linear, Vercel, Notion or Figma, a design system you built and maintained, work on interfaces where people review or correct AI output, founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup.

This is probably not for you if 

- You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch.

- You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning.

- You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane.

What you get 

- Real equity, and compensation that reflects a high bar

- Genuine ownership of product surface area from day one, with the founders in the room

- Relocation support and visa sponsorship, handled properly

- Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, and any tool that makes you faster

- A small team with high standards, high trust, and no politics

If this sounds like your kind of problem, apply. A short note on the hardest thing you've built goes further with us than a polished CV.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER 

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics. 

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS 

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale.

Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation.

You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

- Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS 

- Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible 

- Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably 

- Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms 

- Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability 

- Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls 

- Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives 

Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED 

- 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments 

- Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting 

- Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments 

Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflows Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainability Experience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutions Deep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. 

Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional: 

- Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure

- Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2.

- Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services

- Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) 

- Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) 

- Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE 

- In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions.

- In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud.

WHY CATAPULT? 

- We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.

- We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 

- We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.

- Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness. 

- We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.
