title: GTM Enablement - Partner Program
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

As a Partner Enablement Program Manager, you'll build and run the ElevenLabs partner academy for systems integrators, hyperscalers and technology partners. You'll create curricula across sales, pre-sales and technical implementation, starting with ElevenAgents and expanding across ElevenCreative and ElevenAPI. You'll work closely with our regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who bring the technical expertise and set the technical quality bar. Your mission is to grow the program to 10,000+ certified partner professionals by the end of 2027, and to make the ElevenLabs certification a credential the tech ecosystem respects.

As a Partner Enablement Program Manager, you can expect to:

- Build curricula for partner sellers, pre-sales and implementation engineers: courses, hands-on labs and assessments.

- Turn expert knowledge from our FDEs, sales and product teams into a world-class online academy.

- Run the certification program end to end, from submissions and review workflows to certificates, with FDEs making the technical call.

- Scale the program through automation, from automated agent review to bots and emails that support learners.

- Deliver training online and in person, including sales and technical sessions at our partner hackathons.

- Run program administration: the learning platform, partner onboarding tracks, reporting and learner feedback.

Requirements 

We're looking for an enablement builder who is comfortable with both commercial and technical topics. You don't need to be the deepest expert in the room, but you need enough depth to work with senior engineers and sellers as subject matter experts and turn their knowledge into great learning. You'll thrive with us if you:

- Are passionate about AI, technology and ElevenLabs products.

- Have built enablement or training programs at scale for partners, sellers or technical teams.

- Learn technical products quickly and can explain them to both technical and commercial audiences.

- Can run a program end to end: learning platforms, timelines, stakeholders and reporting.

- Can lead a session or workshop in front of sellers and engineers.

- Have strong instructional design skills: you can turn expert content into clear courses, labs and assessments.

- Enjoy turning repeat work into automations, tools and agents.

- Have excellent communication skills and can adapt your message to different audiences.

Bonus: 

- Experience as a forward deployed engineer, solutions engineer or in professional services for a frontier AI product.

- Hands-on experience building LLM applications or voice and chat agents, and reviewing whether they are ready for production.

- Familiarity with Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks and common integration patterns.

- Telephony experience, such as SIP, Twilio or contact center platforms.

- Experience at a systems integrator, hyperscaler or technology partner.

- Experience with learning platforms such as WorkRamp.

- Proficient in Spanish or Portuguese.

Growth Potential 

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

- Leading a partner enablement team as the academy grows.

- Moving into partner program leadership or Solutions Engineering.

Location 

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in North America, with the ability to operate in Americas timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in New York or San Francisco.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Backend Engineer
description:
Engineering · Amsterdam (hybrid) 

Inner Circle is a dating app for people who are done wasting time. Every member is screened thoroughly, so the profiles you see are people worth dating. 

Every AI-powered feature starts with the data and infrastructure behind it. From building scalable backend systems to powering smarter matching and personalisation, our engineers turn data into meaningful connections - and shape how AI transforms the future of dating. 

Goal of the Role 

You power the engine that brings more members together every second. We’re moving our backend from a PHP monolith to Kotlin services, and changing how we build software at the same time: AI and agentic engineering are part of how our team works every day. You’ll join the team building the new part of our system, and occasionally work in our legacy PHP codebase. 

You don’t need prior PHP or Kotlin experience. We care more about how you think and approach problems than about which language you have used so far. 

Tech stack: Kotlin, Spring Boot, GraphQL, PHP 8 (legacy), MySQL (Aurora), Redis, OpenSearch, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), AWS (S3, SNS/SQS, SES, Rekognition, and more), DataDog 

Result Areas: 

Build and ship features that matter to members 

Deliver backend features that improve matchmaking, engagement and retention. You work from outcome-based stories: the team agrees on the result, and you own how to get there. 

Help move our platform to Kotlin services 

Build new Kotlin services and help extract functionality from the PHP monolith step by step, without disrupting the members who use the app every day. 

Work with AI, and with judgement 

Use AI and agentic tools such as Claude Code in your daily work. Give them clear specs and context, and review what they produce as critically as you would review a colleague’s code. 

Own the quality of what you build 

Write clean, testable code with automated tests, keep pull requests small, follow secure coding practices, and stay responsible for your code once it runs in production. 

Make pragmatic trade-offs 

Reason through problems and ship solutions that are good enough. Recognise when something needs more care or optimisation, and ask for input when a decision is bigger than your part of the system. 

What you bring: 

- 3+ years of experience in backend engineering 

- Proficiency in at least one typed backend language, such as Kotlin, Java, C#, Go, TypeScript or PHP 

- Solid experience with APIs and relational databases, including query performance 

- Understanding of systems design and software architecture, and the ability to reason about trade-offs 

- You know why clean code matters and you apply it, with or without AI 

- Experience writing automated tests and working with CI/CD 

- Hands-on experience with AI coding tools, or a strong drive to learn agentic engineering practices 

- Clear communication in English, both spoken and written (design docs, decision records, pull request descriptions) 

Nice to have: 

- Experience with AWS 

- Experience with event-driven systems or microservice architectures 

- Familiarity with Domain-Driven Design or clean architecture 

- Experience with Kotlin or the JVM 

- Experience working in, and gradually migrating, a legacy codebase 

You: 

- Curious, and keen to try new tools and ways of working 

- Focused on outcomes rather than output 

- Pragmatic: you know when good enough is good enough 

- Comfortable asking questions and explaining your reasoning 

- An authentic team player 

What we offer: 

- A fulltime job that makes a positive impact on people's lives 

- A competitive salary matched with your experience and ambition 

- An amazing work environment in our office at Prins Hendrikkade, at the heart of Amsterdam 

- A Macbook or other hardware of your choice to be able to do your job 

- Stay healthy and bring your own device allowance 

- Training and development budget 

- Frequent team get-togethers and team activities 

- Free Inner Circle VIP membership for you and your single friends 

About Inner Circle 

Inner Circle is a dating app built on the contrarian belief: opposites don't attract. The best connections happen between people who already live life the same way. So we don't sell more options, or better odds. We sell relevance, people worth dating. Every member is screened, so effort and intention are in place before anyone gets in. And where every other app is built to keep you swiping, ours is built to get you off it, and onto a date with someone worth your time. 

At Inner Circle, we embrace our diverse community and team. We celebrate differences and know that they are key for helping us grow. Our team consists of 40 team members, with 16 nationalities and a female: male ratio of 60 : 40. Whatever your race, religion, colour, gender, national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability or age, we make sure everyone has the space to be themselves. 

Ready to make an impact? Let's get the ball rolling, apply now.

title: ENGINEER/POST-DOC POSITION OFFER : in Stretchable Electronics & Optics for Artificial Skin – 12 months
description:
Joining Mines Saint-Étienne means committing to an institution where science and innovation build a more sustainable future. It is a school of excellence where everyone has the opportunity to unlock their full potential and contribute to tackling the challenges of tomorrow.

Ranked among the top engineering schools in France and recognized worldwide, our school, a member of the Institut Mines-Télécom , educates the talents of tomorrow while actively addressing major industrial, digital, and environmental challenges. By joining us, you become part of a community of 500 members of staff, 2,500 students and take part in an ambitious project: combining academic excellence, cutting-edge research, and positive societal impact.

The Institut Mines-Télécom brings together France’s leading Grandes Ecoles to tackle major industrial, digital, energy, and environmental challenges. With its eight public Grandes Écoles and two affiliated Graduate Schools, it is the leading public institute dedicated to engineers and managers. Together, we imagine and build a sustainable future by educating the leaders who will shape tomorrow’s transitions.

🎯 What we expect from you 

As a Postdoctoral Researcher or Research Engineer, you will perform research and innovation activities in the field of soft electronics and optical sensing for artificial skin applications. Within the Centre of Microelectronics and the Flexible Electronics Department (FEL), you will contribute to the development of stretchable optical waveguides and their integration into artificial skin demonstrators.

The flexible electronics department develops technological and scientific knowledge in the field of soft electronics. The department has a strong knowledge in the field of material and interface electrical and mechanical characterization. The activities of the department are regrouped in the 660m2-area platform. This technological platform regroups facilities and technological equipment for R&D activities in Micropackaging, micro and nano-electronics, in a clean room of 220m² 1000-class and 400m² 10000-class.

Stretchable electronics can also be combined with optical systems such as waveguides. These devices will be developed to create artificial skin with pressure and temperature sensing capabilities.

Within this project, the work will focus on the fabrication and characterization of stretchable optical waveguides, as well as on fabrication and integration techniques for optical components (LEDs / photodiodes). A related publication is “Transparent, Optical, Pressure-Sensitive Artificial Skin for Large-Area Stretchable Electronics” (https://doi.org/10.1002/adma.201200523).

The main activities will include:

· Fabrication and characterization of elastomer waveguides for pressure and temperature sensing applications.

· Integration of optically pressure- or temperature-sensitive materials into the elastomer waveguides.

· Characterization and validation of complete sensing devices.

The fabrication processes and experimental setups are already available. However, good knowledge of Python is important for operating and further developing the test benches. Hands-on laboratory work is essential and will be partly performed in our clean room facility.

The expected outcome is the demonstration of radically new soft optical sensing devices with features and functions that cannot be achieved with conventional electronic approaches. This work is part of a European project involving multiple partners across Europe, including ETH Zurich (ETHZ), the University of Oxford, Johannes Kepler University Linz, EMPA…

🔍 What we are looking for 

You hold a: 

· Bac + 5 diploma or equivalent, or a PhD degree in engineering sciences, electronics and embedded systems, or a related field

And you have: 

• You should be autonomous, curious, rigorous, and passionate about technological innovation. A strong interest in practical work and experimentation is essential, together with the ability to develop a rigorous scientific approach.

• Knowledge of optics, photonics, soft electronics, materials science is an asset.

• Knowledge of clean room environment is an asset.

• Good knowledge of electronic design and circuitry is highly appreciated.

• Good programming skills in Python; experience with Arduino and/or Raspberry Pi is an advantage.

🌍 Why join Mines Saint-Étienne? 

We support each of our employees on the path to excellence, with the conviction that together, we can have a lasting and significant impact on our world.

Joining Mines Saint-Etienne is the opportunity to find: 

• A stimulating environment: Cutting-edge experimental resources, a welcoming working environment and a solid international network (T.I.M.E., EULIST).

• A real impact: Contractual research projects worth €11 million/year, mainly with industrial partners, A science culture centre, La Rotonde , which has been committed to science outreach for 25 years, welcoming over 50,000 visitors per year.

• An incomparable quality of life: 49 days of paid leave, partial remote working, 75% reimbursed public transport, financial support for carpooling and cycling and a social barometer where 83% of employees praise the quality of life at work.

title: Product Lead
description:
About Abound 

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.

And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.

Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.

The Role 

We are hiring a Product Lead to own our Express / Mid-prime personal loan product, one of our highest-priority growth areas. This is unsecured personal lending in the higher-APR mid-prime space (30% to 50% APR), with loans typically from £2,000 to £10,000, and customers acquired primarily through price-comparison and aggregator marketplaces. Our ambition is to grow this product many times over while improving its economics, and this role owns the product that makes that happen.

This is a product role first. You will own the Express/Mid-prime proposition end to end: who we serve, how we quote and present offers on marketplaces, how the journey converts, how we price, and how the product performs once the loans are on the book. What makes it different from a typical product role is that the product is credit. The levers that drive growth, such as eligibility, pricing, offer design and underwriting, are the same levers that drive loss rates, so you need to be comfortable working with risk and data science rather than handing that part off.

We think this is a great role for someone with around four to five years of experience who has built a strong foundation in lending or fintech, has worked hands-on with data and credit decisioning, and is ready to own a product outright rather than a slice of one. You will set the direction for the segment, run the roadmap, and be accountable for the results, with the backing of experienced risk, data science and commercial leaders around you.

Our decisioning is built on Open Banking and cashflow underwriting rather than credit scores alone. For a higher-APR population acquired through marketplaces, seeing real affordability is what lets us select and price better than the market. The interesting product problem is that richer data comes at a cost to conversion, so the job is to capture that data advantage while designing a journey and offer that customers actually complete.

The defining challenge is balance: scaling volume by an order of magnitude while building a book of genuinely good credit quality. The best people in this space know that those two goals can be reconciled rather than traded off, and are curious enough to work out how.

What you'll be doing 

- Own the Express / Mid-prime product: proposition, roadmap, performance and economics, with direct accountability for the balance between growth and credit quality.

- Lead how we quote and present offers across aggregator and price-comparison marketplaces, optimising eligibility, risk-based pricing and offer presentation to win the right customers at the point of acquisition.

- Own conversion through the journey, from quote to disbursal, including how we ask customers for Open Banking data and how that affects drop-off and the quality of the book.

- Understand and actively manage adverse selection in marketplace-acquired lending, shaping offer, pricing and decisioning strategy to attract the customers we want and screen out the risk we do not.

- Work with data science to make sure our credit models are calibrated and tuned for this population rather than inherited unchanged from prime or adjacent segments, and be able to get into the data yourself when needed.

- Use credit and commercial insight to optimise unit economics, balancing approval rates, pricing, loss rates and volume so the product scales profitably.

- Monitor product and portfolio performance across the customer lifecycle, spotting emerging trends, risks and opportunities early.

- Shape underwriting strategy, segmentation, credit policy and decisioning logic in partnership with risk and data science.

- Design and evaluate experiments and strategy changes, and turn the analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.

- Own the management information for the segment: define the metrics, monitoring and reporting that let the business make consistent decisions about the product.

- Assess new initiatives, customer segments and product changes with both a commercial and a credit lens.

- Present clear, structured updates on product performance to senior leadership and governance forums, and support funding and due diligence conversations where the product is in focus.

Who you are 

- A product person at heart: you care about the customer, the journey and the commercial outcome, and you want to own something end to end.

- Quantitative and hands-on. You are comfortable in SQL and Python (or similar), you can interrogate a dataset yourself, and you can hold your own in a conversation with data scientists about model performance and calibration.

- Credit-literate. You understand how eligibility, pricing and underwriting decisions shape the book you end up with, and you have a working understanding of adverse selection and why it matters in marketplace lending.

- Commercially sharp, with a solid grasp of unit economics and a clear understanding that product decisions in lending have to work for both growth and portfolio performance.

- Curious about trade-offs rather than defensive about them: alert to the fact that deeper affordability assessment can hurt conversion, and motivated by the challenge of capturing its value without sacrificing growth.

- Able to move between detail and direction: happy getting into the data on a Tuesday and shaping the roadmap on a Wednesday.

- Confident challenging assumptions and turning analysis into practical action, and able to explain your reasoning clearly to people who are not analysts.

- Collaborative and credible with risk, commercial, engineering and data science teams.

- Structured, proactive and comfortable in a scaling environment where priorities evolve quickly and ownership is expected.

Experience and background 

- Around four to five years of experience in product, credit strategy, analytics or a closely related role within consumer lending or fintech. We are deliberately targeting this level: this is a step-up role for someone ready to own a product, not a lateral move for someone who has run several.

- Experience in unsecured consumer lending, ideally Unsecured Personal Loans (UPL), with exposure to the mechanics of acquiring customers through price-comparison or aggregator marketplaces. Direct experience in higher-APR or near-prime lending is a strong plus but not a prerequisite.

- Hands-on data skills: SQL as a minimum, and ideally Python or R for analysis. You do not need to be a data scientist, but you need to be able to work alongside them as a peer and do your own analysis.

- Experience working with or alongside credit decisioning, scorecards or risk models, and an understanding of how they are built, monitored and adjusted for a specific population.

- Some experience of pricing, eligibility or offer design, and of using experiments or A/B tests to evaluate changes.

- A track record of using analysis to influence decisions, not just to report on outcomes, in a role where you had some accountability for commercial results.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to senior stakeholders.

- Experience with Open Banking data or cashflow underwriting is a plus, as is experience in a fast-growing fintech.

What we offer: 

- Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity

- Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office

- 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays

- 2 paid volunteering days per year

- One month paid sabbatical after 4 years

- Employee loan

- Free gym membership

- Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

title: Quality Assurance Engineer II
description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.

- We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.

- We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.

- We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

Become a Quality Engineer for Bloomreach! 

The Data Pipeline team is a backend-focused engineering team that cares deeply about quality and reliability. We believe in autonomy, we trust data, and we own what we ship end-to-end. We move our customers' data in and out of Bloomreach Engagement reliably and at a high rate:

- Our clients feed their visitors' behavior through real-time tracking to our platform. The data then can be analyzed and used for marketing automation. We process tens of thousands of requests per second .

- Imports are critical for our clients to utilize our platform to the fullest. We import millions of rows of data and continuously improve the throughput and reliability of our imports and integrations with other data storages.

- We are also responsible for exporting data from our platform to Google's BigQuery using Google's DataFlows, PySpark and Apache Beam, allowing data access by our clients.

- We run and support our services in production, handling high-volume traffic using Google Cloud Platform and Kubernetes .

Every one of these flows is something our customers rely on being correct, at scale. That is the terrain your testing and automation will cover.

You won't be doing this alone: you'll join an experienced Senior Quality Engineer already on the team, so you'll have a buddy to ramp up with, bounce ideas off, and share the quality mission with from day one. We work remotely first (from Central & Eastern Europe), but we are more than happy to meet you in our nice offices in Bratislava, Brno or Prague. And if you are interested in who will be your engineering manager, check out Adam's LinkedIn .

Intrigued? Read on 🙂 ...

What challenge awaits you? 

As a Quality Engineer in Data Pipeline, you own quality for systems that move huge volumes of customers' data in real time, at scale, across many integrations. This is a backend, data-heavy world: a tracking API on one side, an internal message format and multiple storages on the other, with Kafka, GCP and Kubernetes in between. Guaranteeing quality here means understanding how data flows end-to-end and where it can go wrong.

We need you to bring engineering rigor to that quality. Concretely, you will:

- Own end-to-end and integration testing. Complex data pipelines can behave correctly component by component yet still surprise you end-to-end. You design the tests that validate real behavior across components, so we can ship changes to high-scale integrations with confidence.

- Build automation that runs repeatedly in CI. Turn testing into automated integration and end-to-end suites (e.g. Robot Framework, API tests) wired into the deployment pipeline, giving engineers fast, reliable feedback on every change.

- Go deep in the imports domain. Imports are a rich, well-defined area with plenty to reason about. You'll build deep context so you can proactively tell the team what to test, how, and why , and where the edge cases hide.

- Shift left. Be part of grooming and design from day one, thinking about test cases and failure modes while features are being shaped rather than after the fact.

- Strengthen the pipeline core too. Beyond imports, help raise quality across the Data Pipeline core as you grow context.

- Partner with the developers. Quality is a shared responsibility: developers own their in-source tests and you add the outside-in automation layer and perspective. You make the whole team better at testing, not the place work gets handed off to.

Your responsibilities 

- Design and own black-box, API-level and integration/end-to-end test automation for Data Pipeline services, primarily in the imports domain.

- Build and maintain automated test suites in CI/CD (GitLab) that gate deployments and catch regressions across components.

- Read Go/Python pipeline code well enough to find holes and design meaningful test cases - you don't need to ship features, you need to understand the system.

- Drive test strategy in grooming and design reviews - test types on the ticket, acceptance criteria, edge cases, failure modes.

- Pair with our current Data Pipeline QA to spread automation and code-adjacent testing practices across the team.

- Use telemetry and reproduction to turn production incidents into durable, automated regression tests.

Our tech stack 

- Languages: Python (primary), Go (enough to read pipeline code)

- Test automation: Robot Framework (API/integration and Browser-based E2E), CI-driven suites in GitLab, with ReportPortal / Allure reporting

- Platform you'll test against: Apache Kafka, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, BigQuery, MongoDB, Redis

- CI/CD & tooling: GitLab, Jira, Confluence

- AI coding agents: Cursor, Claude Code, ...

- ... and much more 🙂

Your qualifications 

Must have 

- You write test automation in code - integration and API tests in CI, in Python / Go or a similar language.

- You can read backend/pipeline code (Go or Python) well enough to find gaps and reason about where a change can break something else. Useful QA sees the cross-component failure the feature author might missed.

- You are comfortable owning black-box, API and integration/end-to-end automation - the outside-in layer. (In-source unit and in-repo integration tests remain with the feature developers.)

- You want to work primarily in code and automation . If you are coming from a mostly manual testing background, that is fine - as long as you are excited to make automation your main craft, because that is where this role lives.

- You are comfortable in grooming and design from day one - a shift-left mindset, defining test types and cases on the ticket before code is written.

- You can learn and adapt - essential when navigating a large codebase and a data domain that mixes tracking, imports, and multiple storages.

- You know how to be effective in a remote-first environment.

- Fluent use of AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Gemini CLI, or similar) as part of your daily workflow.

Strongly preferred 

- Prior backend exposure (an internship or role where you wrote code, or worked under a senior who set up proper testing/automation workflows) - it makes the pipeline world far less of a black box.

- Experience with ETL / data-pipeline testing: connectors, ingest at scale, data cleanup and transformations, and validating data landing correctly in target storages.

- Experience testing systems built on Kafka, GCP, or BigQuery.

- Familiarity with test frameworks such as Robot Framework, Playwright or API testing tooling (Postman and beyond).

Personal qualities 

- Ownership - you take quality from detection through to a durable, automated fix that prevents the next regression.

- Systematic thinking - you find root causes, not symptoms, and you document what you learn so the team levels up.

- Collaboration - you make developers better at testing rather than becoming the place work gets "thrown over the wall".

- Curiosity - you enjoy peeling back a data pipeline until you understand what can go wrong and why.

Your success story 

In 30 days 

- Get to know the Data Pipeline team, the company, and the most important processes.

- Set up your local and cloud development environment and complete the Engagement engineering onboarding.

- Understand how our pipelines work end-to-end - tracking, imports, exports - and how we approach testing and automation, with a focus on the imports domain.

In 90 days 

- Deliver your first meaningful quality improvement: an automated integration or end-to-end suite for a real imports flow, wired into CI so it gates deployments.

- Be active in grooming and design reviews, defining test cases and surfacing edge cases and cross-component risks before implementation.

- Pair with our current QA to share automation practices and broaden the team's quality coverage.

In 180 days 

- Own the quality posture of the imports domain end-to-end - the team relies on your suites and your judgment on what "tested" means.

- Drive measurable improvements: more of the pipeline covered by repeatable automated tests, faster feedback in CI, and higher release confidence across the team.

How We Use AI 

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. description:

About NetDocuments 

At NetDocuments, we're shaping the future of legal work. We believe legal professionals should spend less time searching for information and managing documents, and more time solving complex problems, serving clients, and delivering meaningful outcomes. That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge.

Our team is redefining what's possible for legal technology. NetDocuments is the trusted intelligent document management platform for legal professionals and the company behind the industry's first and only legal context graph—a breakthrough that gives legal professionals and AI a richer understanding of how matters, documents, people, and knowledge connect across an organization while respecting enterprise-grade security, governance, permissions, and ethical walls.

Innovation is only part of our story. We believe our greatest strength is our people. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact. Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms.

That commitment to our employees and customers has earned us recognition as one of the nation's top workplaces, including:

- Four consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies

- Five-time Top Workplace USA winner

- Five-time Salt Lake Tribune Top Workplace 

- Multiple Top Workplaces Culture Excellence awards recognizing innovation, employee appreciation, work-life flexibility, and compensation & benefits

If you're excited to solve meaningful challenges, work alongside talented colleagues, and help define the next generation of legal technology, we'd love to meet you.

What You’ll Do 

NetDocuments is seeking an Engineering Manager to lead a team responsible for building and delivering shared AI capabilities across our platform. In this role, you will drive engineering execution, guide technical direction, and lead the development of scalable, secure, and reliable AI-powered solutions that enhance how legal professionals work. 

You will partner closely with Product, Architecture, and senior engineering leaders to translate emerging AI technologies into meaningful product capabilities. This is a technical leadership role focused on driving delivery, developing engineering talent, and ensuring our AI solutions meet the highest standards of quality, performance, and enterprise readiness. 

You will: 

Drive Engineering Delivery & Execution 

- Lead the planning and execution of engineering initiatives, ensuring predictable delivery of high-quality AI capabilities. 

- Partner with Product and Architecture to translate customer needs and emerging AI technologies into scalable, secure solutions. 

- Balance feature development with system reliability, performance, cost efficiency, and operational excellence. 

- Proactively identify technical risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs, communicating recommendations to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. 

- Establish clear priorities, accountability, and engineering practices that support consistent delivery. 

Guide AI Technical Strategy & Architecture 

- Partner with Principal and Staff Engineers to guide architectural decisions, technical direction, and implementation strategies for AI-powered solutions. 

- Evaluate AI model selection and technical tradeoffs, including response quality, latency, scalability, and cost. 

- Guide the development of prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches to deliver accurate, contextually relevant AI experiences. 

- Establish expectations for AI evaluation, testing, and monitoring, including regression testing for model and prompt changes. 

- Ensure AI capabilities meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, compliance, and reliability. 

- Leverage technical knowledge of C#/.NET, microservices, containerization, and AWS or Azure to evaluate designs, remove blockers, and support engineering decisions. 

Lead, Mentor & Develop Engineering Talent 

- Lead, coach, and develop a team of software engineers, supporting performance, career growth, and technical development. 

- Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, experimentation, and continuous improvement. 

- Drive hiring and talent development efforts to build a high-performing engineering team. 

- Encourage the adoption of modern engineering practices and AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and software quality. 

- Create an environment where engineers collaborate effectively, challenge assumptions, and continuously improve technical solutions. 

Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration & Alignment 

- Partner with Product, Design, Architecture, and other AI engineering teams to align technical priorities and shared platform capabilities. 

- Communicate engineering progress, technical decisions, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders and senior leadership. 

- Build strong cross-functional relationships that support efficient decision-making and successful product delivery. 

- Translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes and recommendations. 

What You’ll Need to Be Successful 

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years managing engineering teams. 

- Experience delivering production-grade AI or LLM-powered features within an enterprise SaaS environment. 

- Strong understanding of large language models (LLMs), including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context limitations, latency, cost considerations, and common failure modes. 

- Familiarity with AI evaluation methodologies, retrieval systems, and approaches for measuring model accuracy, reliability, and performance. 

- Understanding of AI agent architectures, tool-calling patterns, and emerging integration standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). 

- Strong technical foundation in modern software engineering, including distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native architectures. 

- Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure and modern engineering practices including CI/CD, containerization, and observability. 

- Working knowledge of C#/.NET or similar backend development technologies, with the ability to evaluate technical designs and guide engineering decisions. 

- Demonstrated ability to lead engineering teams, manage competing priorities, and deliver complex technical initiatives. 

- Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and business decisions. 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

What Will Make You Stand Out 

- Experience developing AI-powered solutions within legal technology, document management, or other regulated industries. 

- Experience building and scaling document AI capabilities, including intelligent document processing and retrieval systems.

title: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote)

About the Role: 

An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human. 

We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics. 

Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences. 

Our Core Technologies 

Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools. 

What You'll Do 

• Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout 

• Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge 

• Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff 

• Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most 

• Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs 

• Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers 

• Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context 

• Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior 

• Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts 

• Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone 

• Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks 

What We Look For: 

• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles 

• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails 

• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates 

• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes 

• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms. 

• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved 

• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response 

• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal 

Nice To Have: 

• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect) 

• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling 

• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design 

• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2) 

• Conversation design or UX writing experience 

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan 

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance 

• Flexible PTO 

• Opportunities for professional growth and development
• Paid parental leave 

• Health & wellness initiatives

title: Software Developer, Quantitative Platform
description:
About Winton

Winton is a research-based investment management company with a specialist focus on statistical and mathematical inference in financial markets. The firm researches and trades quantitative investment strategies, which are implemented systematically via thousands of securities, spanning the world's major liquid asset classes. Founded in 1997 by David Harding, Winton today manages assets for some of the world’s largest institutional investors.

We employ ambitious professionals who want to work collaboratively at the leading edge of investment management.

We seek a highly skilled developer with strong computer science fundamentals to join our Quantitative Platform team. This team is responsible for developing the core platforms that underpin and provide data to the research and trading of our quantitative investment strategies, alongside tools, APIs, libraries, and user interfaces to support this.

In this role you will work closely with our research and other technology teams to deliver high impact projects that improve our ability to predict and trade movements in global financial markets.

Our Technology 

Operating in a cloud-first environment, we predominantly write our backend systems in C# but otherwise make pragmatic choices for each scenario. This often means Python with C++ employed in performance-sensitive cases.

Our applications are written with containerisation in mind from the outset and deployed as a Docker image into Kubernetes on AWS where we can scale on-demand to satisfy burstable workloads. We make extensive use of Kafka for low-latency communication across applications and use a mixture of different technologies for storage, from S3 to relational databases. We utilise GitHub for source control and Jenkins for CI, though with an increasing interest in GitHub Actions.

We constantly evaluate our stack to ensure we’re using the most appropriate technologies for the needs of our business and the efficient delivery of those requirements.

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Build and maintain a world-class platform that enables storage, transformation, and testing of data at scale by leveraging the latest open-source software, cloud, and distributed computing technologies.

- Gain a deep understanding of the requirements of our research teams to deliver business-critical functionality in a timely-manner.

- Collaborate with the team through active contribution in code reviews, knowledge-sharing, and design discussions.

- Write and maintain good quality, well-tested code across services, data storage and UI layers.

What we're Looking For: 

- A Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or equivalent technical field. 

- 2+ years of professional software development experience, including C#, Python or C++

- Comfortable using agentic AI coding tools such as Claude Code and are genuinely keen to use them as a natural part of daily work

- Collaborative nature and ability to work in a team e.g., partnering with portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, and other technologists.

- Strong interest in keeping abreast of latest technologies and a measured approach for adopting them.

- Comfortable with problem solving across multiple technologies and business domains.

What would Be Useful: 

- Experience engineering systems for the cloud-based storage and processing of large datasets or using frameworks such as Spark and open standards like Parquet and Arrow.

- Experience working with other cloud and related technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.

- Experience working as a software developer in the quantitative hedge fund space.

- Experience building web applications using front-end frameworks such as Angular. 

Equal Opportunity Workplace

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Finance
description:
Jij zorgt dat AI niet bij een financiële pilot blijft, maar helpt in het echte werk. 

Een slimme AI-demo maakt indruk. Maar pas als analisten en medewerkers er elke dag mee werken, wordt technologie waardevol. Zeker in finance, waar betrouwbaarheid, controleerbaarheid en regelgeving nooit bijzaak zijn.

Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je erbij vanaf het eerste gesprek. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig.

Wat ga je doen? 

Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf.

- Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value.

- Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers.

- Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf.

- Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg.

Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar.

Van KYC tot complexe financiële processen 

Je kent de werkelijkheid achter KYC/AML, klantacceptatie, klachten- en schadeafhandeling, financiële rapportage, risk en compliance. Denk aan:

- KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen.

- Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam.

- Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act.

Wat breng je mee? 

- Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit.

- Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security.

- Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

- Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

- Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup.

- Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met DORA, model risk management of audit trails, en met klassieke ML zoals fraude- en risicomodellen.

Wat dit níet is 

- Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

- Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken.

- Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie.

- Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan.

Het team 

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. 

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. 

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk 

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

- Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

- AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

- adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen 

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons? 

- €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

- 8% vakantiegeld;

- Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

- Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris;

- 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

- €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

- Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

- Goede pensioenregeling;

- Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor;

- Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team;

Zullen we kennismaken? 

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

- Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met assetmanagement, slimme-meterdata of OT/IT, en met klassieke ML zoals lastprognoses.

Wat dit níet is 

- Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

- Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken.

- Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie.

- Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan.

Het team 

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. 

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. 

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk 

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

- Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

- AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

- adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen 

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons? 

- €5.850–€7.150 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

- 8% vakantiegeld;

- Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

- Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris;

- 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

- €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

- Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

- Goede pensioenregeling;

- Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor;

- Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team;

Zullen we kennismaken? 

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

- Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or similar platforms.

- Experience with MongoDB Atlas, Ops Manager, or comparable MongoDB tooling.

- Experience with capacity planning, cloud cost optimization, and workload performance tuning.

We build with AI. We lead with judgment. 

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer, Document Intelligence
description:
Headquarters: New Jersey, USA

URL: https://vertican.com 

About the role

For 40 years Vertican has buildt software that runs law firms. One year ago we created a new modern AI platform for document automation (processing/extraction/redacting) which our customers have been adopting faster than any product we've ever had. Our suite of AI-enabled products save customers thousands of hours each week by processing high volumes of documents with precision and speed.The AI team is growing and we'd like you to join.

We are hiring an engineer to own the document processing pipelines end to end: design, benchmarking, experimenting with new architectures and tools, threshold required for deploying a new pipeline, etc.

We believe it's important to build our own tooling to help us run, improve, and measure our applications. Therefore, the ideal candidate thinks outside the box on how to not just build the product/pipeline, but also the tooling needed around it.

You will be the first dedicated ML hire on the product taking over from the engineering manager who build the current solution and will work directly with the founding engineering team.

This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role, but we are small team and you'll be involved in design, planning, roadmapping, and architectural decisions.

What you will do

Design the pipelines. Own the architecture of the extraction-to-posting pipelines: page classification, field extraction, candidate retrieval, claim matching, confidence gating and the hand-off to human review, etc. Decide where rules end and models begin, and what each stage must guarantee to the next, what the separation of concerns are, etc.

We have different pipelines for different document types and expect that at any given point in time we may have new ones emerge and may consolidate others.

Evaluate new systems before we adopt them. Run structured trials of candidate components and recommend what to keep. Examples include probabilistic record linkage (Splink), Azure AI Content Understanding and Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI and Foundry-hosted models, and LLM agents with tools. Similarly, test new models with the existing pipeline as they are relased from the frontier labs.

Build the evaluation process. You'll own the process of evaluating false positives, false negatives, errors of ommission, etc, that we ultimately use to determine if we should upgrade the pipeline. 

Ship and operate. Take components from trial to production in our python workers on the cloud, instrument them, watch cost and quota, and diagnose the cases reviewers send back.

Set direction. Work with leadereship on the planing for accuracy, cost improvement, and overall product improvements.

What we are looking for

Required 

- 6+ years building ML or data-intensive systems, at least 3 of them owning a production pipeline whose output people acted on.

- Solid backend engineering understanding and ideally cloud architecture understanding.

- Ideally hands-on experience with document understanding: OCR or layout models, field extraction from scanned PDFs, or intelligent document processing products.

- Experience with entity resolution or record linkage at scale (Splink, Dedupe, Zingg, or your own blocking-and-scoring system) against databases of hundreds of thousands of rows.

- You have designed an evaluation from scratch: built a labeled ground-truth set, chosen the metrics, and defended a threshold to a non-technical stakeholder.

- Production experience with LLM APIs, including structured output, tool calling and cost or rate-limit management; you can say when an LLM is the wrong tool.

- Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable reading Postgres query plans and writing the raw query when the ORM gets in the way.

- Engineering/Scientist mindset: you are scientific about testing the pipeline and how results are interpeted/presented.

Nice to have 

- Azure AI services (Content Understanding, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, Foundry) or the AWS and GCP equivalents.

- Financial document processing: checks, remittance advices, lockbox files, payment matching, or accounts receivable automation.

- Exposure to collections, legal operations or other regulated workflows handling PII.

- Probabilistic matching theory (Fellegi-Sunter) or active-learning labeling workflows.

- Experience building human-review tooling or feedback loops that feed back into training and evaluation data.

How we work and what we offer

Small team, direct access to large datasets, weekly planning, daily standup, everyone remote in US timezones.

What we offer:

- A small team of tight-knit, like-minded people passionate about high quality software

- Competitive compensation, commensurate with a senior individual-contributor role.

- Monthly payments in USD

Vertican is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vertican-senior-applied-ai-engineer-document-intelligence

title: Software Engineer - Simulation Platform
description:
WHO WE ARE 

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

- You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world

- Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey

- Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent

- Shape the future of Proxima’s simulation platform : we design and develop the platform; stellarator researchers and engineers use it to mature the design of Alpha and Stellaris; you will imagine and build with us novel solutions for simulation tools that spark joy and reduce time-to-insight

- Accelerate Stellarator R&D, at the company at its forefront : we work side by side with researchers and engineers to ensure what we build immediately boosts the speed Proxima Fusion’s Stellarator design program

You will join the Simulation Platform Team, a software platform team that balances development of core products with direct support to researchers, adapting to the Stellarator design program’s strategy and priorities. In your first six months you will e.g. add features to our in-house simulation pipeline automation system and ensure that AI agents can work with it efficiently.

- Python libraries enabling automation of large-scale simulation workflows

- cloud-based data storage that keeps everyone in sync

- web applications that foster cross-domain collaboration and knowledge discovery

- integration of AI tools where they actually provide leverage

- You will also work together with our researchers to apply our tools to specific use cases , working as an internally-deployed Research Software Engineer: you will guide users to make the most of the available simulation tooling and proactively co-develop applications that unblock their R&D program, while gathering precious feedback and ideas for the next platform improvements

- We are looking for a software practitioner with a user-first mindset, interested in tackling a diverse mix of challenges: from the optimization of scientific computing workflows to building cloud- and web-based systems for data management, sharing and exploration

- Proficient in Python

- You enjoy staying up to date with current software development best practices and tools, e.g. agentic development or modern data pipelines and scheduling solutions

- You enjoy diving into new problems with a continuous learning attitude, absorbing relevant domain knowledge in a dynamic start-up environment; no fusion background needed, familiarity with scientific software use cases is a plus

- Familiarity with one or more of the following is desirable but not required: full-stack web development (React, TypeScript, FastAPI), Pydantic, JAX, cloud services and cloud-based applications; data management systems

- You don't need to tick every box. If this role excites you, please apply

title: International Expansion - Netherlands
description:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here .

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the Dutch market. 

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.

This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.

You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing 

- Owning Axle’s commercial results in the Dutch market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

- Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

- Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

- Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and eventually on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

- Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

- Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

- Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.

You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.

This is an opportunity to deliver first-of-a-kind projects in one of Europe’s most important flexibility markets, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of electrification.

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in the Netherlands. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.
