title: Director, Engineering (Platform)
description:
About Juniper Square 

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time. 

About your role 

As the Director, Engineering you will lead the vision and execution for the foundational systems that power our entire engineering organization. Your mandate spans four critical pillars: architecting the modularization of our core Python/FastAPI monolith, accelerating our transition to an AI-native engineering culture, empowering product teams with tools to build AI-enabled features, and establishing a robust Application Security (AppSec) posture.

You will manage a group of engineering managers and staff engineers. You will act as a strategic multiplier for the company, treating our internal platform as a top-tier product. Your ultimate goal is to create secure, high-velocity "paved paths" that make our product teams incredibly fast, while systematically reducing technical debt and security risks.

What you'll do 

- 
Direct the Monolith Evolution: Own the multi-year technical strategy to safely decouple our legacy Python/Jinja monolith into a modern, modular FastAPI architecture using Domain-Driven Design and zero-downtime database migration tactics.

- 
Drive the AI-Native SDLC: Champion the rollout and adoption of AI-assisted coding tools and AI-augmented workflows across the entire engineering organization, systematically measuring and improving developer productivity.

- 
Enable AI Feature Development: Treat the internal platform as a product. Guide the development of intuitive SDKs, data pipelines, and internal tools that reduce cognitive load and allow product engineers to easily integrate LLMs and build AI-powered features.

- 
Lead Application Security (AppSec): Champion a "shift-left" security culture. Embed secure coding practices, automated vulnerability scanning, and threat modeling directly into developer workflows, ensuring our core platform is resilient against modern threats.

- 
Oversee Core Shared Services: Drive the scale, security, and reliability of enterprise-critical systems, including Identity (AuthN/AuthZ, OAuth2, RBAC), Audit Logs, and high-throughput API & MCP Gateways.

- 
Navigate Org-Wide Boundaries: Negotiate complex refactoring timelines with Product leaders and collaborate seamlessly with other Engineering teams and DevOps to align our platform capabilities with infrastructure.

- 
Build a World-Class Organization: Recruit, mentor, and grow a high-performing organization of engineering managers and staff/principal engineers, fostering a culture of architectural pragmatism and deep developer empathy.

Qualifications 

- 
15+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years in engineering leadership, including explicitly managing managers and leading multiple teams.

- 
High AI Fluency: Proven experience architecting systems that support AI features (LLMs, RAG, tool calling) and a track record of driving AI-assisted development tools (AI SDLC) across engineering teams.

- 
An executive track record of successfully guiding massive monolith-to-modular migrations and decoupling shared database schemas in high-traffic, business-critical environments.

- 
Deep strategic understanding of Application Security principles, Identity/Access Management (OAuth 2.0, OIDC), and modern API traffic management.

- 
Strong technical fluency in Python and FastAPI ecosystems, with the ability to guide Staff-level engineers through complex architectural decisions involving both modern APIs and legacy applications.

- 
Exceptional executive communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical, security, and AI trade-offs into business value.

Compensation 

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, bonus, equity and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range is $230,000 - $285,000 USD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

- 
Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

- 
Life insurance

- 
Mental wellness coverage

- 
Fertility and growing family support

- 
Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

- 
Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

- 
Retirement saving plans

- 
Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

- 
Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

title: Dispenser
description:
About Bolt Pharmacy and AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor. 

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

- The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

- The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

- Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025 : We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

- Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026 : Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

- Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028 : Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

- Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030 : Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

- Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035 : With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS 

Being a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy

We are building a world-class team.

As a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to turn prescriptions into treatment patients can count on - safely, accurately and at pace.

You'll be at the heart of our dispensing operation, selecting, labelling and securely packing medicines for patients across the UK. You'll take ownership of your work within your qualified scope, follow dispensing procedures precisely and escalate clinical questions to our pharmacists. Every prescription has a person behind it.

You'll keep quality high as volumes grow. From protecting the cold chain and monitoring storage temperatures to managing stock and checking deliveries, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll report errors and near misses promptly, so we learn quickly and keep improving.

Working alongside pharmacists, fellow dispensers and our stock and customer service teams, you'll help resolve issues before they delay treatment. You'll also support trainee dispensers and spot practical ways to make Bolt Pharmacy's operation more efficient. Your experience will help raise the standard of the whole team.

Great performance means consistently processing 30+ orders per hour while maintaining over 99.5% dispensing accuracy, zero critical errors and full compliance with our procedures. Patients receive the right treatment, colleagues trust your work and we can serve more people with confidence.

This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working standard business hours with possible shift patterns.

You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski .

You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's pharmacists, qualified and trainee dispensers, Stock Control and Customer Service, combining dispensing oversight, shared workloads and patient support.

Key responsibilities

- Get every prescription right: Select, label and prepare medicines accurately within your qualified scope, following SOPs and escalating clinical queries to pharmacists.

- Keep treatment moving: Process and securely pack 30+ orders per hour while maintaining accuracy, safety and compliance.

- Protect every medicine: Maintain cold-chain controls, monitor fridge and room temperatures, and escalate storage deviations immediately.

- Take ownership of stock: Check incoming deliveries, maintain correct storage and rotation, and support stock takes so medicines are available when needed.

- Make quality everyone's business: Record errors, near misses and incidents promptly, keep workstations clean and compliant, follow hygiene and PPE procedures, and suggest practical improvements.

- Raise the team's standard: Guide trainee dispensers, support colleagues and work with Customer Service to resolve patient queries and order updates.

Need to have

- Dispensing qualification: You hold a valid Buttercups certification or equivalent dispensing qualification.

- Experience at pace: You've worked in high-volume dispensing and can consistently meet a target of 30+ orders per hour without compromising safety.

- Attention to detail: You bring exceptional accuracy to medicine selection, labelling and prescription preparation.

- Ownership within your scope: You organise your workload independently, follow SOPs precisely and know when to involve a pharmacist.

- Professionalism: You're reliable, punctual and committed to patient safety and regulatory compliance.

Nice to have

- Qualified experience: You've spent at least a year working as a qualified dispenser.

- Online pharmacy: You understand the demands of dispensing and dispatching treatment to patients remotely.

- Mentoring: You've trained or supported junior colleagues and can explain procedures clearly.

- Stock management: You bring experience in inventory control, stock rotation and keeping a busy dispensary supplied.

- Patient support: You've handled healthcare queries with care, clarity and professionalism.

- Pharmacy standards: You're familiar with GPhC requirements and how they translate into everyday practice.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

- Belief in the mission : We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

- Unwavering integrity : We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

- Only the paranoid survive : Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

- If we're average we fail : We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

- Commitment to candor : That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

- A maniacal sense of urgency : We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

- Enduring frugality : We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

- Bulldozing barriers : The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

- Keep your head down : We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

- The power of focus : We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

🎯 "You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build.

- Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off.

- Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role.

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

- Personal development: A £400 budget for books, courses and coaching to keep building your skills.

- Personal wellness: A £400 budget for the gym and health apps to support your wellbeing.

- GLP-1s: Get free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s, if clinically applicable.

- Health coaching: Access free biweekly health coaching to help you stay healthy.

- Work coaching: Access free biweekly work coaching to stay sharp and calm.

- What are we missing? We're still early, so your ideas can help shape our culture.

title: Python Software Engineer

We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.

What we offer

description:
About Agicap

Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.

Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !

Agicap est en train de devenir une AI-first company . Nous formons l'ensemble de nos employés à travailler avec l'IA et à automatiser eux-mêmes une partie de leurs tâches. Certains projets sont trop longs, trop transverses ou trop techniques pour être portés par une équipe métier seule.

C'est le rôle de l'AI Lab.

C'est l'équipe pivot qui construit les outils internes qui changent la façon dont Agicap travaille au quotidien. Notre boussole : impact opérationnel rapide , itérations courtes, travail à 360° avec toutes les équipes (Sales, CS, Finance, Produit, Marketing, Data, C-level).

C'est une création de poste : l'accélération de l'IA change nos process et notre manière de bosser. On a besoin d'un renfort senior pour accompagner cette transition et l'inscrire dans des pratiques qui tiennent sur le long terme.

L'équipe que tu vas rejoindre : 

- 4 personnes , toi inclus : un ingénieur IA junior , un Tech Lead à mi-temps (qui sera ton manager), un Product Manager .

- Ton rôle : apporter le recul technique qui manque aujourd'hui dans l'équipe (infra, architecture, maintenabilité, scalabilité) — construire vite, mais sans creuser de dette pour demain.

- Tu es en interaction directe avec toutes les équipes métier d'Agicap : c'est un poste très transverse, très exposé.

description:

About Us 

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Job Brief

We are expanding our focus to cover AI-augmented threat intelligence and post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) security. The ideal candidate will combine deep blockchain forensics expertise with working knowledge of machine learning techniques for anomaly detection, and awareness of quantum computing threats to current cryptographic foundations (ECDSA, RSA) used across blockchain ecosystems. We value candidates who can bridge academia and industry and build collaborative relationships with research institutions to accelerate the adoption of emerging cryptographic and AI-driven techniques within the company.

Main Responsibilities of a Blockchain Risk Control Analyst/Researcher

Your main responsibilities will include:

- 
Leveraging LLM techniques to drive the development of next-generation on-chain risk identification and threat intelligence systems, including autonomous agent workflows capable of continuous monitoring, self-triggered investigation, and automated operational responses — reducing manual intervention across the full risk lifecycle from detection to resolution;

- 
Leading forensic investigations on real crypto theft, fraud, and market manipulation cases, integrating AI-assisted pattern recognition to accelerate root cause analysis;

- 
Researching post-quantum cryptographic algorithms (NIST PQC: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and their implications for blockchain security; assessing quantum computing threats to existing cryptographic foundations (ECDSA secp256k1, hash functions) and evaluating migration paths;

- 
Partnering with internal teams and external stakeholders for incident response, and engaging with academic institutions to translate frontier research into deployable security tools;

Key Requirements

- 
You have a Master's or PhD's degree in Blockchain security, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.

- 
You are good at programming languages commonly used in blockchain analytics (e.g., SQL, Python, Javascript)

- 
Experience applying machine learning or AI techniques to blockchain data analysis, fraud detection, or threat intelligence

- 
A strong publication record in top-level industry or academic conferences is highly valued.

- 
You have experience with blockchain monitoring/forensic tools and analytics platforms.

- 
Familiarity with NIST PQC standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and lattice/hash-based cryptography fundamentals is a plus;

- 
Understanding of quantum computing threats to elliptic curve cryptography and implications for key management in Web3;

- 
You have security or risk control experience as a plus.

- 
You possess effective communication and collaboration abilities.

- 
English is essential, and proficiency in Mandarin can be an advantage.

At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

- Use AI tools every day to code, explore, analyse and report faster, verify what they produce, and present your results to the team

- Machine learning methods, and how to validate them properly

- Clear, reproducible code and reports

- Explaining results to technical and non-technical colleagues

- Curious and adaptable, happy to work quickly and test ideas against the evidence

title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
description:
Who we are 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 

About the role: 

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

- You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.

- You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.

- You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will: 

- Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.

- Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.

- Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention. 

- Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.

- Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.

- Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.

- Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.

- Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role. 

- 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.

- Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.

- Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.

- Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.

- Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.

- Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.

- Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.

- Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.

- Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.

- Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.

- Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.

- Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity 

We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

title: System Test Automation Engineer
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Verification and Release Test Team 

Wayve’s Verification and Release Test team sits at the intersection of hardware, embedded software and machine learning models. Our testing spans component, system and vehicle levels, and we build novel test automation in-house to identify issues earlier in development. We pride ourselves on finding the most efficient and effective ways to deliver the most valuable results for the company.

As a System Test Engineer, HIL, you’ll build robust, reusable automation and work across engineering disciplines to improve coverage, reliability and traceability. This is a hands-on delivery role with room to grow into broader areas of the system, including sensing and model-behaviour testing, as Wayve and your experience evolve.

🧠 Your day-to-day 

- Develop automation for system functionality tests at component, integration and system levels, working across software and hardware boundaries.

- Lead root-cause investigations for failures identified during test campaigns, collaborating with hardware, software, infrastructure and DevOps teams to resolve issues.

- Analyse test results, uncover software and hardware bugs, and report findings through Jira with clear evidence to support debugging.

- Optimise Buildkite CI/CD-integrated test workflows for rapid, reliable and repeatable execution.

- Review, create and follow risk assessments to ensure all testing activities are conducted safely and responsibly.

🧩 What you’ll be working on: 

- Independently owning the design and delivery of automated verification for a defined area of our embedded software stack, steadily raising the bar on coverage, reliability and traceability.

- Building open-loop and closed-loop hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) replay tests, alongside reliability and fault-injection tests, to support verification, release and debugging.

- Automating HIL test setups and improving test infrastructure to expand coverage, make failures easier to trace and strengthen compliance reporting.

- Integrating requirements, coverage and compliance workflows, including Jama, MC/DC coverage analysis and MISRA checks, and managing test artefacts through Artifactory and Azure.

- Developing traceability dashboards and defining KPIs and quality metrics that support data-driven validation and release decisions.

🙌 You should apply if: 

- You have hands-on experience with system-level verification and validation in robotics, embedded software or mechatronic systems, with a track record of independently delivering test automation.

- You’re highly proficient in Python and have experience developing automation test frameworks using pytest.

- You’ve worked with HIL testing and tooling, including interfaces such as CAN, Ethernet or GMSL, and tools from dSPACE, Vector, Xylon or similar providers.

- You understand open-loop and closed-loop HIL replay testing using dSPACE or other emulators.

- You’re familiar with automotive safety and process standards, including ISO 26262, ASPICE and SOTIF, and have experience integrating requirements and test-management tools such as Jama and Xray.

- You’re proficient in CI/CD principles and related tooling, such as GitLab CI, Buildkite and Bazel.

- You have experience developing or testing automotive software at embedded and system levels, including hardware/software interactions and interface-level testing, and have worked with L2+ hands-off, L3 or L4 automated driving systems.

- You have knowledge of consumer safety-rating protocols such as Euro NCAP, including AEB and LSS/LKA scenarios; DCAS regulatory testing under UN R171; and automotive cybersecurity testing and standards, including ISO/SAE 21434 and UN R155.

- You’ve worked with test automation dashboards, logging and reporting infrastructure, using tools such as Grafana, Looker, Datadog and Jira.

- You’re a self-starter with a sharp eye for improvement who communicates clearly and works effectively across software, hardware, autonomy, DevOps and product teams.

- Ideally, you’ve contributed to improvements in test methods, safety procedures or operational efficiency, and are familiar with data management and version control tools such as Git.

- Experience using agentic AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude Code to accelerate and improve test development, debugging and automation workflows would also be valuable.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve: 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: 

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process: 

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

- Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes)

- Competency Interviews (Programming and hiring manager interview; 1 hour 45 minutes total)

- Deep-dive technical interviews (Cross-functional, system design; 1 hour 45 minutes total)

- Final interview : mission & values alignment (45 minutes).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: Applied ML Engineer - Edge Devices
description:
Company Overview 

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm 

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

About the role

Deepgram's speech models are among the fastest and most accurate in the world, and today we run them at scale on NVIDIA GPUs. Our customers increasingly need those same models on hardware we don't control: non-NVIDIA accelerators, edge servers, and embedded platforms with their own inference runtimes, operator sets, and constraints. Getting Deepgram models onto those platforms, with as few changes to the model as possible and no changes to the hardware paradigm, is the job.

As an Applied ML Engineer on the Partner Platform Engineering team, you sit one layer above the metal. You take a Deepgram model as it exists today and adapt it to run correctly and efficiently within a target platform's existing kernel and runtime paradigm: swapping or reshaping operators, adjusting architecture parameters, choosing quantization and precision schemes, and validating accuracy and latency on the real device. Where a standard kernel isn't enough, you work with our Embedded AI Engineers, who write the custom kernels, and fit the model to what they build. You also own the deployment process that gets those adapted models onto edge targets repeatably.

This is not a research role and not a cloud-serving role. It is applied ML for edge deployment. It is a great fit for a senior engineer who has already shipped models to non-GPU or edge hardware and wants to do it across many platforms, or a staff-level engineer who wants to define how Deepgram ports speech models to new hardware. We'll set the level to your experience.

What you'll do

- 
Port Deepgram speech models to non-NVIDIA and edge platforms, adapting model structure and parameters so they run within the target's existing operator set, runtime, and kernels with minimal modification.

- 
Own serving-side model decisions for edge targets: quantization and precision choices, operator substitution, graph rewrites, and architecture tweaks that fit a model to a device's constraints while holding accuracy and latency.

- 
Validate every port on real hardware: build accuracy, latency, throughput, and memory benchmarks per platform, and catch regressions before a customer does.

- 
Build the deployment path for edge targets: model packaging, conversion pipelines, versioning, and automated delivery so shipping a model to a new device is repeatable rather than bespoke.

- 
Work with Embedded AI Engineers when a standard kernel isn't enough: specify what the model needs, then adapt the model to use the custom kernel they deliver.

- 
Partner with platform and silicon vendors on their runtimes and toolchains, and turn their expected model format and operator conventions into a working Deepgram deployment.

- 
Feed edge constraints back to Research and Impeller so future models are easier to port, without taking on research or core productionization work yourself.

- 
As the team grows, take on adjacent production concerns at the edge: automated deployment, model security and integrity on customer hardware, and fleet-level observability.

You'll love this role if you

- 
Have already fought to get a model running on hardware that wasn't built for it, and want to do that across many platforms.

- 
Prefer changing the model to fit the hardware over changing the hardware to fit the model, and know when each is the right call.

- 
Care about the numbers on the device, not the numbers in the notebook.

- 
Like being the bridge between the team writing kernels and the team training models.

- 
Want to ship to customers, not publish.

It's important to us that you have

- 
Hands-on experience deploying ML models to edge or non-NVIDIA hardware in production. This is required. Cloud-only or GPU-only serving experience does not qualify on its own.

- 
Working knowledge of quantization and precision tradeoffs (INT8, FP16, mixed precision, calibration) and how they affect accuracy and latency on real targets.

- 
Experience with at least one edge or vendor inference runtime and its conversion toolchain (for example ONNX Runtime, TFLite, ExecuTorch, OpenVINO, Qualcomm AI Engine, or a vendor NPU SDK).

- 
Ability to modify a model to fit a platform: reading and rewriting model graphs, swapping unsupported operators, and adjusting architecture parameters without breaking accuracy.

- 
Strong Python and PyTorch, and production-quality engineering habits: tests, reproducibility, and benchmarks that others can rerun.

- 
Comfort building automation around model conversion and deployment.

- 
A builder mindset and clear communication: you can scope a port on an unfamiliar platform and drive it to a measured result.

It would be great if you had

- 
Experience with speech, audio, or streaming/real-time models specifically.

- 
Exposure to writing or reading low-level kernels (CUDA, Metal, NEON, or vendor DSP code), enough to collaborate closely with embedded engineers.

- 
Experience with model security or integrity on deployed devices: signing, encrypted model storage, safe updates.

- 
Familiarity with several accelerator families (Qualcomm, Apple, ARM, Intel, AMD, or custom NPUs) and their quirks.

- 
A track record of building internal tooling that made porting or deploying models measurably faster.

Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
In a world where geopolitical tensions and security threats are accelerating, the way nations protect people and preserve peace is being redefined. For a long time, innovating in defense was about making tougher hardware. But with the evolution of software and the recent AI disruption, the future of defense is shifting to software-powered unmanned systems that save lives by removing humans from the front line. This is our mission.

At Intelic, we're building the intelligence layer for unmanned systems in defense. As a software-first company, we enable autonomous platforms to operate together - faster, smarter, and more reliably - across complex, mission-critical environments. Our technology turns disconnected assets into coordinated forces, helping operators make accurate decisions when it matters most.

Based in Amsterdam and growing fast, Intelic offers a rare opportunity to work on products that don't just move metrics - they meaningfully impact safety, resilience, and the future of Europe's security.

Why This Role Exists

Nexus has to run in places most software never goes: offline, in the field, installed and operated by people who are not developers. Getting it there in one piece, and keeping it running, is a job on its own.

Right now that job sits mostly with three backend engineers who cover this alongside their own work. As Nexus grows, so does the team, and we're adding someone to take real ownership of the pipelines, installers, and infrastructure that turn Nexus into something operators can trust, and who treats security as part of how the work gets done, not a separate project bolted on afterwards.

What You Will Do

You will join Product Adoption, the team that owns the last stretch between working software and a field-ready product: deployment, installers, monitoring, and everything that keeps Nexus running once it leaves the building. We are hiring at medior to senior level, roughly a 2 to 3, with room to flex higher for the right person.

- Build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines that turn Nexus into an installable, field-ready product across Linux and Windows

- Maintain and harden our software supply chain, including dependency scanning and package security

- Own the Windows installer and service orchestration, and help developers debug the platform-specific issues that come with it: permissions, firewalls, services, "works on my machine"

- Secure the software update server, the one online touchpoint in an otherwise offline system, and keep telemetry from the field reliable without leaking sensitive data

- Harden APIs and authentication on the surfaces that face the outside world

- Maintain and gradually take over our on-prem infrastructure: physical servers, backups, and disaster recovery, as we move away from renting machines in the cloud

- Build small internal tools, mostly in Python, Rust and shell or PowerShell scripts: installers, updaters, and the occasional internal or customer-facing web app

- Support incident response when things break in production, and help build the monitoring that catches problems before customers do

- Write down what you learn, so the next person, including future you, doesn't have to debug the same thing twice

You'll Thrive Here If

- You bring solid experience with CI/CD pipelines and build automation

- Comfort working across both Linux and Windows, with the ability to actually debug problems on either, not just deploy to them

- Experience with infrastructure as code (Ansible, OpenTofu, or similar)

- A security mindset: hardening, secure defaults, and attack surface are just part of how you build things, not an afterthought

- Enough scripting or programming ability to read and contribute to Python, Rust, or shell scripts. There is there is plenty of custom tooling to build.

- A level head under pressure. You can prioritise and stay steady when a few things break at once

Nice to have: 

- Experience with on-prem, bare-metal or virtulized infrastructure, not just cloud consoles

- Familiarity with Docker

- Exposure to dependency and package scanning tools such as Sonatype

- An interest in platform or infrastructure engineering as its own discipline. We expect this to split into a dedicated function over time

- Ability to build in-house tooling where needed and integrate vendor solutions where they fit

What Your First Year Will Look Like

- You've taken over meaningful parts of the CI/CD pipeline and installer work independently, without needing step-by-step instructions

- You've hardened at least one exposed surface end to end, the update server, an API, or similar

- You've helped move part of our infrastructure off rented machines and onto hardware we run ourselves

- Developers come to you when something breaks on Windows or Linux, because you've built a track record of finding the actual root cause

- You've documented enough of what you know that the team is less dependent on any one person, including you

Why Intelic

- We are setting up an environment, largely from the ground up that has to approved by MoDs

- You won't be bored. New projects, new problems, and a steady stream of things nobody has solved here before

- Real ownership from day one, not ticket-taking. If you see a better tool or approach, you're free to try it

- You'll work with hardware that matters: servers you can walk up to, deployments running in places with no internet, problems that cloud-only engineers rarely see

- A small team that leans on each other. When someone's on leave, the rest pick up the slack, and vice versa

- The mission is real. Nexus supports operators in the field, and how well you build and secure it has a direct effect on whether it works when it counts

What We Offer

- Stock Appreciation Rights programme (equity)

- A vibrant office at NDSM Plein, Amsterdam Noord — where we come together in person every day, because we believe it matters for the kind of work we do

- Flexible pension plan

- 25 vacation days

- Travel allowance

- Urban Sports corporate membership

- Lease a Bike option

Please note that, as part of our recruitment process, we may request a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and conduct a background screening in accordance with our screening policy. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation throughout this process.

- Build and enhance reporting and visualization assets that support day-to-day pricing decisions and strengthen performance oversight.

- Communicate complex technical findings as clear recommendations and tangible next steps for commercial leaders without a technical background.

- Collaborate with data science, finance, and marketing to measure discount impact consistently across gross and net revenue and short- and long-term customer profitability.

- Collaborate with and mentor analysts within the team, championing scalable, automated, and reproducible ways of working.

What You'll Bring

- A motivated, collaborative mindset with strong team-working skills and a passion for solving complex business problems.

- 4+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field — ideally in a fast-paced B2C or subscription business.

- Strong SQL and Python (required) — you're comfortable owning an analysis end to end.

- A foundation in experimental design and A/B testing , including how to size a test and choose primary and guardrail metrics.

- Working knowledge of causal inference and econometrics — price elasticity, incrementality, and quasi-experimental methods.

- Solid applied statistics , and familiarity with common machine-learning methods (regression, trees, clustering; uplift / heterogeneous-effects a plus) — with the judgment to know when a method genuinely helps and when a simpler approach is better.

- A strong understanding of Marketing and Growth metrics and how they connect to overall business performance.

- Comfort in a modern data stack (Databricks / Spark / a SQL warehouse) and a visualization tool ( Tableau , Looker, or Power BI; or apps built in Streamlit).

- A results-oriented, structured approach , able to turn vague or ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks and insights.

- Proven project ownership and stakeholder management , especially in senior or cross-functional settings.

- Excellent communication skills in English , with the ability to explain analytical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making.

Nice to have:

- Pricing, discounting, or marketing-analytics domain experience.

- Market Insights / market-benchmarking experience supporting senior leadership.

- Bayesian or hierarchical / mixed-effects modeling.

- GenAI / LLM tooling for analytics (e.g., natural-language-to-SQL, agent or assistant surfaces).

title: Business Application Engineer (m/w/x)
description:
Gestalte die digitale Zukunft von Finance & HR aktiv mit! 

Du möchtest nicht einfach nur bestehende Systeme verwalten, sondern Geschäftsprozesse aktiv verbessern, moderne Technologien vorantreiben und Verantwortung für eine zentrale Business-Applikationslandschaft übernehmen? Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für Dich sein.

Unser Kunde ist eine Organisation mit einem gesellschaftlich relevanten Auftrag im Bereich der digitalen Transformation. In einem dynamischen und technologieorientierten Umfeld werden digitale Lösungen entwickelt und betrieben, die einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Modernisierung zentraler gesellschaftlicher Strukturen leisten.

Im Mittelpunkt Deiner neuen Aufgabe stehen zwei zentrale Business-Applikationen: Oracle NetSuite und Personio . Beide Systeme sind bereits etabliert und sollen nun weiter stabilisiert, intelligent miteinander vernetzt und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. Darüber hinaus spielen Automatisierung und der Einsatz künstlicher Intelligenz eine zunehmend wichtige Rolle.

Zur Verstärkung des IT-Teams suchen wir eine technisch versierte Persönlichkeit, die Geschäftsprozesse versteht, gerne hands-on arbeitet und die Weiterentwicklung der Systemlandschaft aktiv mitgestalten möchte..

Deine Aufgaben

- Systemverantwortung & Weiterentwicklung: Du übernimmst die Konfiguration, Administration und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Oracle NetSuite und Personio. Dazu gehören unter anderem Workflows, Formulare, Rollen- und Berechtigungskonzepte, Saved Searches sowie Reports.

- Business Process Management: Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen Finance, Controlling, Einkauf und HR analysierst Du bestehende Prozesse und Anforderungen und entwickelst passende technische Lösungen – von der Konzeption über die Umsetzung bis zum Go-live.

- Technische Verantwortung: Gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Teammitglied stellst Du den zuverlässigen Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung beider Applikationen sicher. Ihr arbeitet eng zusammen, vertretet Euch gegenseitig und gestaltet die Aufgabenverteilung eigenverantwortlich.

- Steuerung externer Dienstleister: Bei komplexeren Entwicklungen und Schnittstellen arbeitest Du mit externen Implementierungspartnern zusammen. Du hinterfragst technische Konzepte, bewertest Ergebnisse und sorgst dafür, dass das Know-how langfristig intern aufgebaut und gesichert wird.

- Integration & Automatisierung: Du entwickelst die Anbindung der Systeme an weitere Anwendungen weiter und identifizierst Potenziale für Automatisierung und den Einsatz von KI, insbesondere in Finanz- und HR-Prozessen.

- Application Management: Du analysierst und behebst Störungen, begleitest Changes und Releases und unterstützt den Betrieb weiterer Business Applications.

Das bringst du mit

- Qualifikation: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre mit IT-Schwerpunkt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

- Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Konfiguration, Administration und Weiterentwicklung von ERP- oder HR-Systemen mit. Idealerweise hast Du bereits mit Oracle NetSuite gearbeitet. Kenntnisse in Personio oder vergleichbaren HR-Systemen sind ebenfalls willkommen.

- Technisches Know-how: Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis von Skripting, beispielsweise JavaScript oder SuiteScript, SQL-Datenbanken und REST-APIs. Du kannst technische Anforderungen beurteilen und Dich souverän mit Entwicklern und externen Dienstleistern austauschen.

- Prozessverständnis: Du kennst Geschäftsprozesse aus den Bereichen Finance, Controlling, Einkauf oder HR und verstehst es, fachliche Anforderungen in praktikable technische Lösungen zu übersetzen.

- Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und pragmatisch. Auch bei komplexen Fragestellungen behältst Du den Überblick und findest lösungsorientierte Ansätze.

- Persönlichkeit: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern und hast Freude daran, gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und IT-Kolleg etwas zu bewegen.

- Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden Dein Profil ab.

Deine Vorteile

- Sinnstiftende Aufgabe: Du arbeitest in einer Organisation, deren digitale Lösungen einen gesellschaftlich relevanten Beitrag leisten.

- Langfristige Perspektive: Dich erwartet eine unbefristete Festanstellung mit langfristigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

- Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen: Neben einem attraktiven Gehalt profitierst Du von 30 Urlaubstagen sowie zusätzlichen freien Tagen an Heiligabend und Silvester.

- Flexibles Arbeiten: Deine Arbeitszeit kannst Du flexibel gestalten. Mobiles Arbeiten innerhalb Deutschlands ist nach Absprache möglich. Für die Position ist eine Präsenz im Büro an etwa zwei bis drei Tagen pro Woche vorgesehen.

- Arbeiten aus dem europäischen Ausland: Zusätzlich besteht die Möglichkeit, bis zu 30 Tage jährlich aus EU, EWR oder der Schweiz zu arbeiten.

- Weiterentwicklung: Individuelle Weiterbildungsangebote, Workshops, Fachveranstaltungen und Konferenzen unterstützen Deine fachliche und persönliche Entwicklung.

- Gesundheit & Mobilität: Du profitierst unter anderem von Gesundheits- und Sportangeboten sowie einem Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket.

- Team & Kultur: Dich erwartet ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Abstimmungswegen, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit und einem starken Fokus auf gemeinsames Lernen.

- Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit einer Beschäftigung in Teilzeit unterstützen die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben.

Interesse geweckt?

Du möchtest Deine Erfahrung im Bereich Business Applications einbringen und die Weiterentwicklung moderner Finance- und HR-Systeme aktiv vorantreiben?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen! Sende uns Deine Unterlagen und lass uns gemeinsam herausfinden, ob diese Position der nächste passende Schritt für Dich ist.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École. 

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques. 

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret. 

Transitions numériques, écologiques, industrielles : les grands défis de notre époque sont aussi ceux de l’Institut Henri Fayol. 

Ici se mêlent Informatique, Sciences des données, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, Génie environnemental pour penser les systèmes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, filières industrielles. 

📊 Résilience, performance, durabilité… Nous développons et expérimentons en lien étroit avec les acteurs socio-économique pour répondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles. 

✨ Une recherche interdisciplinaire à fort impact, où l’humain est toujours au centre. 

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous 

Dans le cadre du projet MACMIA de massification des compétences et métiers de l’IA, vous contribuerez au développement de plateformes pédagogiques impliquant un ensemble de ressources logiciels en interaction avec des objets physiques dont des robots programmables. La principale plateforme de ce type, MaqIT, est géré et maintenu par l’Institut Henri Fayol en mettant en relation des ingénieurs et des enseignants-chercheurs qui utilisent la plateforme pour des travaux pratiques en Intelligence artificielle.

Ce recrutement doit servir à soutenir les activités de formations proposées dans le cadre du projet MACMIA , qui est une réponse à l’appel à manifestation d’intérêt France 2030 sur les compétences et métiers d’avenir en IA, et qui impliquent 7 établissements d’enseignement supérieur, 3 campus des métiers et qualification, 2 pôles de compétitivité, 7 entreprises, 1 opérateur de compétence ainsi que France Travail.

Sous la direction du responsable du département Informatique et systèmes intelligents (ISI), vous assurerez un ensemble de missions d’ingénierie. Plus précisément, les objectifs sont :

- Participer à l’amélioration de la plateforme MaqIT : développer des interfaces interactives facilitant l’utilisation des composants connectés de la plateforme (robots mobiles, bras robotiques, convoyeurs, capteurs et actionneurs divers)

- Maintenir les logiciels pour l’exploitation des composants connectés (mises à niveau et tests)

- Intégrer les nouveaux composants connectés et assurer leur fonctionnement avec le reste du matériel, notamment en déployant des interfaces interactives pour faciliter leur utilisation

- Aider à la conception de contenu pédagogique en lien avec les plateformes et les logiciels développés (pour les travaux pratiques sur l’interaction avec l’humain et le monde réel ou les graphes de connaissances et le raisonnement)

- Définir des scénarios pédagogiques exploitant la plateforme MaqIT (fil rouge dans le cadre du Défi Intelligence Artificielle du cycle Ingénieur civil des mines).

Pour ce projet, vous serez amené à dialoguer avec les ingénieurs du pôle ingénierie de l’Institut Henri Fayol et avec des enseignants-chercheurs.

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons 

Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme de Master (Bac+5) ou équivalent et possédez :

• Une expérience confirmée en conception logicielle

• Une bonne maîtrise de la programmation (notamment Python, C++ ou Java)

• Connaissances dans les technologies de l’IA

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

• Connaissances de l’environnement ROS (Robot Operating System)

• Conception d’interfaces utilisateurs et UX Design

• Pratique des outils d’apprentissage automatique

title: Stage M2 : Recherche en optique non linéaire appliquée à la caractérisation de dispositifs électroniques neuromorphiques - 6 mois
description:
Mines Saint-Etienne est une Ecole de l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT), 1er groupe public d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France. L’IMT est un EPSCP (grand établissement) sous la tutelle du Ministère de l’Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté Industrielle et Numérique.

L’École Nationale Supérieure des Mines de Saint-Étienne (Mines Saint-Etienne) est chargée de missions de formation, de recherche et d’innovation, de transfert vers l’industrie et de culture scientifique, technique et industrielle.

Mines Saint-Etienne représente: 2 400 élèves-ingénieurs et chercheurs en formation, 480 personnels (150 Chercheurs et Enseignants-chercheurs), un budget consolidé de 46 M€, 3 campus dédiés à l’industrie à Saint-Etienne et Lyon (région AURA), à la microélectronique et aux objets connectés à Gardanne (Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence, région SUD) et à l’ingénierie pour la santé à Saint-Etienne ; 6 unités de recherche ; 5 centres de formation et de recherche ; un centre de culture scientifique technique et industrielle leader en France « La Rotonde » (> 50 000 visiteurs / an).

Contexte scientifique et objectifs du stage : 

Des dispositifs d’électronique organique ultra-flexibles, conformables et implantables incorporant une intelligence artificielle promettent de révolutionner la surveillance et le traitement en temps réel de maladies chroniques [1]. De tels systèmes pourraient être basés sur des transistors organiques électrochimiques (OECTs), exploitant des conducteurs polymères mixtes ion-électron (PMIECs) comme couches actives. En effet, les PMIECs sont apparus comme une excellente plateforme matérielle pour interfacer la biologie avec l’électronique conventionnelle ; identifié comme le domaine de la « bioélectronique organique ou plastique ». L’OECT est considéré comme l’éléments clé pour réaliser une telle interface [2]. Son efficacité est évaluée suivant des figures de mérite (FoMs) telles que i) la transconductance (gm), et/ou ii) les temps de commutation (ionique vs. électronique) dans le dispositif. Au-delà des applications de transduction, à court terme, l’OECT est aussi intéressant pour créer des applications émergentes en matière de circuits neuromorphiques bioélectroniques [3].

La réalisation de tels circuits est freinée par un manque de compréhension et d’optimisation des processus de conduction mixte dans ces matériaux polymériques ; notamment une asymétrie des temps de commutation des transistors lors des séquences de dopage (i.e « ON ») vs dédopage (i.e « OFF ») dans le canal de l’OECT. Des outils de caractérisation in-situ & operando permettant de quantifier et cartographier les paramètres de transduction électronique et électrochimique dans le canal de l’OECT se révèlent être indispensables pour comprendre les limitations actuelles en performances des PMIECs et/ou pour construire des PMIECs optimums dans de tels circuits neuromorphiques.

Dans ce contexte scientifique, le.la stagiaire développera une nouvelle mesure de spectroscopie et instrumentation d’optique non linéaire, appelée microscopie par génération de second harmonique résolue en temps, afin d’enregistrer le mouvement spatio-temporel des espèces chargées, ion et électrons (ou trous), et ainsi donc cartographier les mobilités électroniques in-situ & operando le canal de l’OECT.

La.le stagiaire fabriquera ces dispositifs OECTs en salle blanche de microélectronique, et bénéficiera d’un accompagnement technique pour leur réalisation. Il.elle enregistrera et analysera les FoMs clés grâce à l'expérimentation d’optique non linéaire développée et aux caractérisations électriques et électrochimiques afin d’établir, de manière plus globale, des règles d’ingénierie dans ces PMIECs qui serviront de socle de connaissances incontournables à l’avenir, pour mettre en œuvre et appliquer des circuits neuromorphiques à base d'OECTs, comme première brique d’une intelligence artificielle d’électronique organique.

Pour aller plus loin :

[2] https://doi.org/10.1038/ s43586-021-00065-8 

[3] https://www.nature.com/articles/s41578-023-00622-5

- Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger 

- Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

- Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

- Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/ 

- Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Tired of being told “that’s not your scope”? 

Plenty of good analysts hit the same wall: you query the data but never build the pipelines, you’re boxed into one lane, and more scope means waiting your turn. Here, it’s the opposite.

Taptap Send moves billions of dollars a month across 6 of 7 continents . We’re probably the largest, fastest-growing money movement business you’ve never heard of. Cards, wallets, business-to-business payments, institutional payments, and new markets are all launching now, and each needs its data, reconciliations and reporting built from scratch. That’s your work.

The job 

You’ll own the external reports the business can’t operate without, then automate them into reliable, reusable dbt models. From day one you’ll work with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product and Data Engineering to make sure every number is modelled correctly.

- Own external reporting: deliver the datasets behind month-end close and regulatory reporting, on time, every cycle.

- Automate: turn multi-day manual work into scheduled pipelines, runbooks and dbt models, so it only gets done once.

- Get ahead of launches: build reports and reconciliations as each product and market goes live, before anyone asks.

- Be first line for data requests: build models so people and AI agents can answer repeat questions themselves.

- Keep data trustworthy: build tests, checks and alerts that catch reconciliation breaks and stale data before they become incidents.

- Share what you know: peer-review code and join our weekly meetups.

Why you’ll want it 

Grow as fast as you’re able. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you’ll own real work early and take on more the moment you’re ready.

Go from querying data to designing systems. Data, product or business analyst? You don’t need to be an analytics engineer yet. Build the pipelines behind the numbers, and learn dbt, testing, automation and AI tooling from senior analytics engineers.

Don't get boxed in. Own the reporting, automate it, then take on our biggest problems wherever they sit. Your hiring manager started in Finance and has since worked across Partner Ops, Fraud, Compliance, Reconciliation and Product.

See the whole business. You’ll follow a transfer from the moment a customer taps send, through partner payout and reconciliation, to the report a regulator reads.

Own numbers that matter. Auditors and Finance rely on what you build. This isn’t a dashboard role.

Put more money in families’ hands. Remittances are a lifeline for millions of families and are worth more than all foreign aid. Every report you automate helps us keep transfers cheap and reliable.

You’ll fit if you have 

1-2+ years in a data or analytics role

A technical or quantitative degree, or equivalent experience

Strong SQL and experience wrangling messy, complex data

Some experience automating repetitive work (e.g. scripts, scheduled jobs)

A strong sense of ownership: when something is broken, ownerless or late, you step in, fix it, and make sure it doesn’t happen again

Reliability under deadlines, a “no task too small” attitude, and comfort chasing stakeholders

The right to work in the UK

Nice to have: startup or scale-up experience, Python or R, dbt, Looker or Mode, and something you’ve built, at work or on the side, because the manual way annoyed you.

Sound like you? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to meet you.

title: Deployment Strategist

About the Team 

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Role Description 

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

The impact you will have 

- C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.

- End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.

Lead technical discovery and design reviews.
